At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. One customer experience that we're constantly looking to take to a new level is how we fulfil and deliver customer orders. Amazon aims to exceed the expectations of our customers by ensuring that their orders, no matter how large or small, are delivered as quickly, accurately, and as cost effectively as possible.
Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager in Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) EU, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimise our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.
As AMXL EU Sr. Supply Chain Manager, Capacity Execution, you will be responsible for managing significant operational and service growth across our European operations as well as implementing standardised process and quality for our Amazon two-person / special handling delivery service. To succeed in this role, you need to be comfortable making business decisions in a fast-paced and evolving work environment and partnering with various functional teams and individuals at all levels of the organisation. This role will include a mix of long-term strategic projects and short-term tactical scope. You will bring strong business judgment, deep curiosity about how things work, strong written and oral communication skills, and a passion for creating effective processes and mechanisms that scale.
The role is responsible for the Production Planning, Labour Planning, and Capacity Execution function for AMXL EU, and is located in our Luxembourg Amazon HQ office, with Barcelona corporate offices also available as an option.
You will collaborate with and present to senior stakeholders to shape network-level strategic decisions. You will bring an analytical background that enables you to support network planning and demonstrate the ability to think broadly and strategically about operational initiatives. You will experience a wide range of problem-solving situations, requiring extensive use of data collection and analysis, in partnership with teams including fulfilment operations leadership, HR, finance, supply chain, transportation, and global system development.


Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Be responsible for Fulfilment Centre, Sort Centre, and Inbound Cross-Dock Labour and Production Planning, Capacity Execution, as well as cost and service optimisation for the EU AMXL network
• Partner with and present to senior leadership, business and finance stakeholders to gather and share data-driven insights
• Support input forecasting using trend analysis and statistical modelling to support decision-making
• Build short, medium, and long-term operational plans to minimise variable costs associated with staffing
• Analyse and solve business problems with a focus on understanding root causes and identifying forward-looking opportunities
• Communicate complex analysis and insights to stakeholders and business leaders, both verbally and in writing
• Participate in global operational and production planning initiatives and project rollouts to support growing business needs
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote process improvement and standardisation across all sites in the network


A day in the life
Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You'll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You'll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to help Amazon achieve new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you'll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.
As a Supply Chain Manager, you'll need to help with both operational tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site's resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you'll be able to learn something new every day.
This role is based at one of our European headquarters in Luxembourg, or at our Barcelona corporate offices.


About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy and bulky items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment, to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we're changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

The ABM Solutions & Implementation team within the AWS Global ABM Practice is chartered to define, build, deploy, govern, and enable the solutions that empower 200+ ABM practitioners globally to operate efficiently and at scale. We create, manage, and support the end-to-end delivery of ABM capabilities — from AI-powered technologies to process automation to content management — ensuring our marketers spend less time on manual execution and more time on strategic customer impact.
We are seeking an ABM Program Manager to own and scale the AI, data, and operational solutions that support our ABM community. This role sits at the intersection of marketing and technology: you will take complex, ambiguous problems and deliver AI-based solutions end-to-end — from problem definition through design, build, testing, and global rollout. You will act as the key partner between ABM stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors, translating strategic ABM objectives into scalable solutions.
This role combines strategic thinking with a builder mindset. You will not simply route requirements to a cross-functional support team — you will assess ABM requirements, and where a solution can be built using out-of-the-box AI tools (such as Amazon Quick, MCP integrations, and Asana), you will build it and enable ABMers to use these solutions effectively. Success means ABM practitioners have an integrated, easy-to-use set of AI-powered tools embedded in their daily workflow that adapt as their accounts evolve — delivered with rigor, field-tested adoption, and measurable impact.


Key job responsibilities
• Serve as the business lead for ABM AI, data, and operational solutions end-to-end — define the vision, program strategy, requirements, and success criteria for AI-based ABM solutions with limited guidance, operating in problem spaces where the solution is not yet defined.
• Design and build AI-powered tools and automation flows from problem definition through production — including customer journey engines, Quick Skill automations, MCP integrations across enterprise platforms (CRM, Highspot, Asana), and reactive signal-monitoring layers that keep solutions current as accounts evolve.
• Drive delivery and support of complex, cross-functional solutions — including design, AppSec compliance, build, user acceptance testing with field practitioners, documentation (SOPs and training guides), product demonstrations, and global rollout.
• Serve as the key partner between marketing stakeholders, cross-functional teams (Martech teams, Marketing Operations, and our Integrated Demand Center), and external vendors — translating business requirements into technical specifications, and communicating technical constraints back to marketing stakeholders.
• Drive AI enablement and adoption across a globally distributed practitioner community — assess AI maturity, build leveling frameworks, deploy Quick Skills tooling, and coach practitioners (e.g., via a Champions program) to scale adoption across all Geos.
• Spot risks and drive appropriate trade-offs — understand design approaches within the ABM technology domain (AI/ML frameworks, MCP integrations, data sources, agent orchestration, UI/UX) and ask the right questions to ensure sound decisions.
• Define, track, and report on program KPIs (adoption, usage volume, practitioner impact, time savings, delivery quality). Use data to identify bottlenecks, drive improvements, and inform investment decisions.

• Partner with the Martech team on ABM solution lifecycle management — contributing requirements and field-informed input to platform builds such as buying-group identification services, account planning platforms, and ABM experience products.

Are you passionate about the future of aviation and helping organisations transform how they deliver safe, efficient, and seamless air travel experiences? Do you have the business acumen and technology leadership background necessary to help establish Amazon Web Services (AWS) as a key technology platform provider across the UK's aviation sector?

This is an exciting opportunity to drive growth and shape the future of cloud-native technology adoption across some of the UK's most critical aviation infrastructure operators — from the world's busiest international airport to the organisation managing millions of flights through UK airspace annually.

You will be joining at a pivotal moment as UK aviation surpasses pre-pandemic passenger volumes, operators face intensifying regulatory and commercial pressure to modernise safety-critical systems, and the UK Government's transport infrastructure investment programme explicitly ties funding to technology adoption. Your role will be to help these organisations harness AI, IoT, and cloud-native architectures for real-time operations management, predictive maintenance, and passenger experience optimisation — where system reliability carries the highest possible safety implications.

You will possess both a customer-obsessed attitude and a strong understanding of how UK aviation organisations operate — from airport operators and air navigation service providers to regulators — and the unique challenges they face when making technology decisions in safety-critical, highly regulated environments. You will have an ability to build relationships at all levels within customer organisations, driving tangible outcomes aligned with the sector's twin imperatives of operational resilience and passenger experience transformation. You are a self-starter who wants to build a business, drive measurable customer outcomes, and make a real difference in how the UK flies.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive revenue growth and market share across the Roads, Regulation, and Regional Transport territory, encompassing National Highways, DfT, TfL, TfGM, TfWM, DVLA, and DVSA
- Develop and execute a comprehensive account development plan aligned with major government investment programmes and customer digital transformation priorities
- Build and maintain long-term strategic relationships with senior leaders across central government departments, arm's length bodies, and regional passenger transport executives
- Develop and articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services including cloud-native analytics, AI/ML, IoT, and data platform modernisation
- Identify and progress opportunities in areas such as multi-cloud displacement, digital twin, legacy migration, real-time traffic management, and regulatory digital services
- Coordinate and manage partner ecosystems to achieve partner-attached rate targets and extend market reach
- Understand the technical requirements of customers and collaborate with Solutions Architects, Specialist teams, and Professional Services to shape compelling solutions
- Facilitate engagement with key officials, policy makers, advisors, and delivery partners across the transport ecosystem
- Present business reviews to senior management regarding progress, pipeline development, and roadblocks to expanding our reach in the territory


A day in the life
As an Account Manager in the Aviation territory, no two days are the same. You might start the morning preparing for a strategic engagement with Manchester Airports Group leadership on their AI-powered Digital Colleague Workplace programme, before joining a cross-functional working session with Solutions Architects and partners to shape a proposal for NATS' next-generation air traffic management platform.

In the afternoon, you could be facilitating a workshop with Heathrow on how data analytics can optimise airport operations and passenger flow, followed by a pipeline review with your manager and specialist overlay teams. You'll regularly engage with DfT aviation policy teams to understand how airspace modernisation and sustainability targets create technology opportunities, and work with the CAA on regulatory digital service transformation.

Your internal stakeholders include Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Partner teams, and Specialist sales overlays. Your customers are senior technology and operational leaders within airports, air navigation service providers, airlines, and aviation regulatory bodies. The problems you solve span infrastructure modernisation, safety-critical systems transformation, data-driven operational efficiency, and enabling the sector's ambition to deliver safer, more sustainable, and better-connected aviation through technology.

About the team
The AWS Transport team sits within UK Public Sector and is dedicated to helping the UK's transport organisations deliver better outcomes through cloud technology. We work across rail, aviation, roads, and regional transport — partnering with some of the country's most complex and strategically important organisations as they navigate generational transformation programmes.

Our mission is to be the trusted technology partner that enables the UK transport sector to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. We believe that cloud, data, and AI are fundamental enablers of the government's vision for a modern, integrated transport network.

We are a collaborative, ambitious team that values diverse perspectives and deep customer empathy. We operate with a start-up mentality within the scale of AWS — meaning you'll have the autonomy to shape your territory strategy while being supported by world-class technical, partner, and specialist resources. We celebrate curiosity, reward ownership, and are passionate about making a tangible difference in how millions of people travel every day.

- Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
- Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility

The Regional Higher Ed Lead is the single point of ownership for AWS Academy within an assigned geographic territory. This role is accountable for growing and managing a portfolio of higher education institutions advising on technical curriculum and cloud/AI strategy and serving as the trusted advisor connecting institutions to the right combination of AWS education programs. You will own the institutional relationship end-to-end - from pipeline development through onboarding through long-term account health - while defining the technical standards and requirements that ensure institutions successfully implement and deliver Academy courses. You will work across AWS teams (sales public sector partner organizations curriculum and platform engineering) to bring coordinated value to higher education institutions in your region.

Key job responsibilities
• Institution Pipeline & Business Development Identify prospect and onboard new institutions into AWS Academy. Build and manage a pipeline of prospective institutions from inquiry through active enrollment. Grow adoption within existing accounts by expanding program presence into new departments and degree programs. Coordinate with AWS Sales field teams on Academy opportunities and identify areas of collaboration with public sector public policy and partner organizations to create scalability.
• Account Management & Relationship Ownership Serve as the primary point of contact for all institutions within the territory. Drive retention expansion and educator readiness across assigned accounts. Build long-term relationships with institutional stakeholders - department chairs deans and provost-level leadership. Shepherd dormant institutions back to active status. Ensure educator nominations and readiness-to-teach milestones are met. Track regional KPIs including learner completions institution growth and educator engagement.
• Technical Advisory & Curriculum Strategy Advise institutions and educators on AWS cloud and AI curriculum architecture course sequencing and how Academy programs map to degree requirements. Communicate technical training standards and curriculum development best practices to institutional partners. Understand and articulate technical aspects of LMS integration (LTI protocols Canvas configuration SSO/SAML) lab environment requirements (Vocareum AWS Labs) and platform capabilities. Define technical requirements for institution setup and ensure institutions can successfully deploy and deliver Academy courses.
• Program Execution & Cross-Functional Coordination Execute global business development and event playbooks locally - including AWS Jams hackathons and vibe coding sessions. Coordinate with the Technical Enablement Lead on content standards and educator readiness requirements. Work with the Business Development & Strategy Lead on go-to-market motions and marketing activities in-region. Advocate internally for institutional needs across AWS teams. Connect institutions to the right combination of AWS programs - Academy Education Equity Initiative Cloud Clubs Skills to Jobs - based on institutional needs.

A day in the life
As a Regional Higher Ed Lead you own AWS Academy across your territory. You start by reviewing portfolio health - pipeline learner completions educator readiness. You advise a department chair on how AWS cloud and AI curriculum maps to their degree programs then dive into technical setup: LMS integration SSO/SAML and lab environments in Vocareum. In the afternoon you sync with Sales on a joint opportunity align with the Technical Enablement Lead on educator readiness and plan an in-region AWS Jam. You re-engage a dormant institution and connect a new prospect to the right AWS programs. You own each relationship end-to-end.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Mentorship and Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

The challenges business intelligence engineers solve for at Amazon are big and affect millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. Our path is not always simple, so we are selective about who joins us on this journey. There is a certain kind of person who takes on this role at Amazon – someone who is excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company whose ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years. How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow. 
At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. The Amazon EU Student Programs Team are looking for ambitious students to join us as interns at the heart of our core consumer business! Internships are flexible in length to fit in with your university’s placement scheme.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop analytical solutions to business problems that utilize the highest standards of analytical rigor and data integrity
• Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation
• Write high quality code to retrieve and analyze data
• Analyze and solve business problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
• Design pragmatic analyses and automated metrics that add value to your business area
• Understand data resources and how, when, and what to use (and what not to use).
• Develop analyses (whether fully formed or exploratory) for the business’ sake, not for analyses’ sake
• Seek to understand the business objectives relevant to your area, and align your work to those objectives and seek to deliver business value
• Proactively and continually, improve your level of knowledge about Amazon’s business and relevant data resources

A day in the life
Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment.

Inclusive Team Culture
Our team is intentional about attracting, developing, and retaining amazing talent from diverse backgrounds. Yes, we do get to build a really cool service, but we also think a big reason for that is inclusive and welcoming culture we try to cultivate every day.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We care about your career growth. Whether your goals are to explore new design concepts, take on bigger opportunities, or get to the next level, we'll help you get there. Our business is growing fast and our people will grow with it.

target_jobs.description:
The EU Same Day Data Team builds the data products behind Amazon's fastest delivery promise in Europe. We are looking for a Business Intelligence Engineer II to own speed and cost metrics across the Same Day network and turn complex operational data into decisions that shape how millions of customers get their orders the same day they place them.

You will design and run the pipelines, dashboards, and self-serve datasets that our business partners rely on every day. If you enjoy working close to the operation, building data solutions that scale, and seeing your metrics drive real network changes, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain ETL pipelines on Redshift that turn raw network events into trusted, reusable datasets.
- Own the reporting for offered-speed metrics (latest order cut-off and click-to-promise) and Same Day grocery volume, from source data to executive-ready dashboards.
- Design and publish QuickSight dashboards and self-serve data products so partners can answer their own questions without a bespoke pull each time.
- Define and document metrics so a single number means the same thing across weekly reviews, OP planning, and ad hoc deep dives.
- Investigate anomalies in speed and volume data, trace them to root cause, and communicate findings clearly to technical and business audiences.
- Partner with operations, program, and finance stakeholders to translate business questions into data models and measurable outcomes.
- Apply high engineering standards to the team's assets: version control, code review, monitoring, and ruthless deprecation of what is no longer used.

A day in the life
You start by checking the health of your pipelines and dashboards. Mid-morning you join a Same Day operations review, where your speed and volume metrics anchor the discussion. You spend focused time building a new dataset for a launch, pairing with a colleague on a QuickSight design, and answering a finance partner's question on cost per unit. Your customers are the Same Day operations, program, and finance teams across EU5, and the problems you solve range from a one-off launch deep dive to the metrics that leadership uses to steer the network.

About the team
Our vision is to scale same-day services in Europe by obsessing about excellent data products for our business customers. We provide the centralized data framework for the Same Day organization, covering cost and other operational metrics. We build accessible and sustainable data solutions that adjust to changing priorities, using data engineering, visualization, and AI technologies. We value clear communication, documentation as a byproduct of the work, high technical standards, and investing in the people on the team.

With global energy demand projected to rise 47% over the next 25 years, the Energy sector is simultaneously navigating a global expansion of existing and new energy sources, an AI driven transformation of subsurface, reservoir intelligence, real-time drilling operations, and agentic production optimization in Oil and Gas; and in Power and Utilities, an acceleration of grid modernization, decarbonization mandates, electrification of mobility, and growth in generation. These are transformational opportunities not seen in decades. At the same time, AWS is deploying billions in annual capital expenditure for power generation and delivery arrangements to support sustainable data center growth. AWS is co-investing in diverse supply like wind, solar, storage, and nuclear and creating more agile, responsive, and efficient energy workflows using AI and the cloud with leading Energy customers. This convergence creates an unprecedented opportunity—and an imperative—for AWS to lead at the intersection of AI, cloud technology, and energy infrastructure. Our mission is simple: to generate unprecedented value for Energy customers by reinventing their workflows with Agentic AI.

AWS is seeking a Director to lead the Business Development function for the Energy and Utilities Industry Business Unit. This leader is responsible for the industry Go-To-Market (GTM) that drives cloud and AI adoption across the Oil and Gas (O&G) and Power and Utilities (P&U) sectors, and for the integration of commercial relationships of companies delivering power to Amazon into a 360, strategic relationship. The Energy BD organization touches every facet of how AWS engages energy and utilities customers and the AWS strategic industry position. The BD team engages in account planning, demand generation, development of cloud and AI Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs), industry go-to-market strategy, solution development, partner ecosystem engagement, and field enablement for AWS Energy customers worldwide.

In this role, you will define and execute the multi-year strategy for how AWS engages the global Energy sector as a customer, partner, and infrastructure counterpart to drive cloud and AI growth. You will lead a globally distributed team of senior business development professionals who structure large, multi-party commercial agreements, manage CxO-level relationships, define the industry strategy, build the opportunity pipeline, enable regional and global account teams, and engage strategic ISV and systems integrator partners to accelerate cloud adoption across the sector. This role that demands credibility at the intersection of energy infrastructure, enterprise AI and cloud technology, and large-scale commercial deal-making.

You will serve as the managed gateway between Energy & Utilities account teams and AWS Infrastructure teams and other Amazon organizations, ensuring that requests and commercial discussions with power procurement teams are appropriately coordinated, triaged, and elevated. You will leverage and continuously expand a pan-Amazon network spanning Amazon Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Sustainability, Amazon Business, and other Amazon business units, bringing the full breadth of Amazon's assets and capabilities into strategic customer relationships. You will facilitate executive engagements between customer C-suites and senior Amazon leadership and represent AWS at the highest-profile energy industry forums.

You will partner with AWS Sales, Solutions Architecture, Professional Services, AWS Infrastructure, and service team leadership to align commercial and technical priorities, influence AWS product and infrastructure investment direction, and build mechanisms that drive repeatable, scalable outcomes across the Strategic BD organization.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and execute a comprehensive strategic GTM plan for the global Power & Utilities sector, including industry solution prioritization, repeatable pipeline generation, market segmentation, and competitive positioning
- Identify, develop, and realize business opportunities to generate customer value and AWS AI/cloud revenue, building a business development pipeline in line with the AWS Energy industry strategic direction and multi-year revenue targets
- Structure and execute Strategic Framework Agreements (SFAs) encompassing Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) and Cloud and AI deployments at scale with the world's largest energy companies
- Lead, develop, and grow a global team of senior business development professionals articulating how AWS can solve the hardest industry problems with Agentic AI and cloud, instilling a sense of urgency, coaching on multi-divisional deal structuring, CxO engagement, providing visible industry thought leadership, and fostering a culture of ownership and high performance
- Serve as the primary strategic advisor to energy industry executives at the CEO, CFO, CIO, CTO, and VP level, building trusted bilateral relationships that span both commercial infrastructure partnerships and enterprise cloud and AI adoption programs
- Manage the pan-Amazon relationship network to bring the full breadth of Amazon assets—Retail, Prime, Transportation, Fulfillment, Data Center Infrastructure, Amazon Business, Sustainability, and others—into strategic customer engagements as inputs to SFA value propositions and commercial deal structures
- Define and size market segments; identify, qualify, and engage key customers and strategic industry partners and develop scalable partner engagement and co-sell motions
- Build and maintain named account/ white-space map across Energy and utilities, prioritized by propensity and strategic value
- Hand off qualified opportunities to Sales with clear documentation of the customer's business driver, stakeholders and urgency
- Coordinate regional and global field enablement initiatives, including account team training programs, infrastructure engagement playbooks, industry solution toolkits, and mechanisms that equip AWS field teams to engage confidently in energy infrastructure and cloud deals
- Work with Marketing to drive global campaigns highlighting customer success stories and strategic messaging.

In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.

Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectations.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Eligibility for UK Government Security Clearance is required for this role (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels)

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and managing complex cloud migration and transformation projects/programmes from inception to completion
• Ensuring successful delivery of project/programme outcomes within agreed time frames, budget and quality parameters
• Developing and executing project/programme level planning with the agility to adjust strategies as necessary to meet evolving business objectives
• Building and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships across customers, partners and internal teams at all levels
• Driving key decisions and resolving project/programme level risks and issues
• Establishing robust governance model, project/programme structure and communication plan
• Leading a multidisciplinary teams of technical specialists
• Ensuring compliance with security, regulatory and governance requirements
• Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
• Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes


A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you don't meet all qualifications, we encourage you to apply regardless of your career path.

Why AWS?
AWS is the world's most comprehensive cloud platform, trusted by startups to Global 500 companies.

Inclusive Team Culture
Employee-led affinity groups foster inclusion, empowering us to embrace our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-advancing resources help you grow professionally.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony and strive for flexibility, so success never comes at the expense of home life.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS offers over 200 fully featured services to millions of active customers around the world—including the fastest-growing start-ups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—to power their organisations and underpin their digital transformation

Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing adoption of AWS in complex enterprises? Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish AWS as a key strategic partner? As we embark on the next stage of our growth, we’re seeking ambitious sale people with a proven track record in account management roles and selling complex IT solutions into large enterprises.

The successful candidate will drive digital transformation through impactful engagements with C-level executives, line of business leaders and technology professionals. In this role, you will represent the entire portfolio of AWS across the highest profile commercial organisations in the UK and with the greatest potential to be the next significant, strategic AWS customers.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services

Are you ready to take on this unique and high visibility challenge?

Key job responsibilities
• Drive AWS business growth in a defined territory supporting early engaged accounts within the Industrials sector; Build and leverage relationships with internal and external stakeholders to further the adoption of AWS services in the market;
• Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales strategies and successful go-to-market engagements to achieve customer outcomes;
• Act in a customer obsessed way that delights our customers, enables innovation, underpins transformation and delivers outstanding outcomes;
• Deliver against a combination of agreed quantitative and qualitative goals;
• Develop and work with partners to extend the reach and drive AWS cloud adoption
• Engage in a way that ensures an outstanding customer experience


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Amazon is seeking a European VAT Senior Manager to lead VAT strategy, risk governance, and policy across multi-jurisdictional operations throughout Europe. This role combines deep technical VAT expertise with strategic leadership, driving scalable compliance frameworks, influencing senior decision-making, and setting the direction for complex, cross-border VAT matters.

Key job responsibilities
This position will lead cross-functional engagement with senior business partners, legal, operations, and tax leadership to shape strategy, define governance frameworks, and drive alignment on complex VAT matters across multiple jurisdictions and business lines. The role requires setting the strategic direction for VAT risk management and influencing organisational priorities at a senior level.
In order to be successful, the candidate must demonstrate strategic vision and high judgment, setting priorities for multi-disciplinary teams, making decisions with significant business, regulatory, or financial implications, and determining where to allocate resources for maximum impact. The candidate must operate with independence and bring clarity to complexity.

The candidate must:
• Have deep, recognized expertise in VAT across multiple jurisdictions, with a proven track record of leading complex advisory engagements, setting organisational tax positions, and influencing business strategy at a senior leadership level; and
• Be able to lead and own the resolution of the most complex audit and controversy matters, developing strategy, managing external advisors, and driving outcomes with tax authorities across multiple jurisdictions.
• Be able to communicate complex VAT matters with clarity and conviction to executive audiences, bringing strategic recommendations, not just analysis, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.
• Be a trusted business partner to senior leaders, effectively influencing and challenging decisions across organisations.



A day in the life
This position owns the strategic direction of VAT planning and risk management across the portfolio, leading large-scale, cross-functional programmes from conception through execution.
The role is accountable for identifying and mitigating material VAT risks, developing and embedding governance frameworks, and ensuring organisational readiness for regulatory change. The incumbent will establish mechanisms for continuous improvement, determine resource allocation, and report directly to senior leadership on exposure, remediation, and strategic priorities.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon's Fleet Procurement and Capacity Planning (FPAC) team manages a large-scale international commercial vehicle fleet across 10 European markets. This fleet depends on accurate, timely data flowing between two Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), Amazon's internal planning systems, and multiple cross-functional stakeholders.

This role owns the operational delivery and quality of all fleet data provided by FMCs (Ayvens and Arval) to Amazon. You will be the single-threaded owner ensuring that vehicle lifecycle data (from order placement through deployment, maintenance, defleeting, and remarketing) is delivered per contractual SLAs, meets validation standards, and flows reliably into the planning tools and reporting mechanisms that drive fleet capacity decisions.

This is a hands-on data operations and vendor management role. You will spend the majority of your time ensuring data reliability, resolving reporting failures with FMC technical contacts, and supporting the internal teams who depend on this data to make procurement and capacity decisions worth hundreds of millions in OPEX annually.

Please note that this is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

Key job responsibilities
1- Maintain Fleet Data Reliability
- Own the end-to-end data delivery relationship with Ayvens and Arval technical points of contact, ensuring reporting against established SLAs and contractual obligations
- Monitor, triage, and resolve data quality issues across SDR (Supply Delivery Reporting) and SRR (Supply Return Reporting) pipelines, including idle stock positions at VIN level
- Support Weekly Business Reviews and Variable Last Mile Rentals reporting cadences by ensuring upstream data is accurate and delivered on time
- Escalate systemic data failures through the appropriate FMC governance channels (Monthly Business Reviews, performance reviews).
2- Enable Planning Tools and Downstream Consumers
- Ensure data feeds into FORCE (Fleet Optimization, Requirement and Control Engine) and FAB (Fleet Allocation and Balancing) meet signal integration requirements
- Partner with the MAPS team (Mid-Term Planning) and Fleet Planning to resolve data gaps that block planning accuracy and automation
- Triage new data requests from internal stakeholders against existing data specifications; eliminate redundancy before placing additional requirements on FMCs
3- Drive Continuous Improvement

- Identify and implement process improvements to reduce manual data reconciliation effort
- Develop monitoring mechanisms to proactively flag reporting inaccuracies before they propagate into planning decisions
- Document and maintain the fleet data catalogue, including ownership, refresh cadences, quality thresholds, and known limitations
- Ensure any new fleet programs (LMR expansion, new country launches, Middle Mile integration) include data requirements in vendor agreements from the outset
4- Cross-Functional Coordination

- Align with Fleet Partnerships (FMC contractual owners), Fleet Deployment & Redeployment, Planning, and GFPA (Global Fleet Planning Analytics) on data priorities and dependencies
- Influence FMC behavior through performance metrics and contractual accountability rather than direct authority
- Represent data requirements in FMC governance forums (MBR/QBR)

target_jobs.description:
Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale. Amazon is seeking an experienced Manager to lead a team of Single-Threaded Leaders (STLs) who own end-to-end program planning, cross-functional orchestration, and delivery governance for complex automation infrastructure deployments across our international fulfillment network.

You will lead and develop a team of program managers who each own full lifecycle delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream — from capital approval and planning through deployment execution and steady-state handover. You will design the governance mechanisms, operating cadences, and scalable frameworks that enable your team to drive predictable delivery outcomes across multiple concurrent programs, countries, and stakeholder organizations.

You will influence within a VP organization, advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy, prioritization trade-offs, and program health, and actively grow the next generation of program leaders.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Berlin, Munich, Barcelona, or London with ~50% travel across Europe during deployment season, with occasional international travel.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a team of program managers operating as Single-Threaded Leaders, each owning end-to-end delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream across planning, funding, deployment, and handover.
- Own the team's operating model, governance cadences, and delivery mechanisms, designing scalable frameworks that drive predictable outcomes across multiple concurrent programs and geographies.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across diverse stakeholder organizations including finance, operations, supply chain, site selection, and engineering to remove blockers and accelerate delivery.
- Own capital governance and program prioritization for the team's portfolio, ensuring CARs, plans of record, and financial commitments are on track and aligned to organizational goals.
- Build scalable planning mechanisms, launch readiness frameworks, and standard work that convert first-time program complexity into repeatable, predictable delivery paths adopted organization-wide.
- Advise Senior Managers and Directors on program strategy, prioritization trade-offs, resource allocation, and risk mitigation, influencing within a VP organization on cross-functional program decisions.
- Make trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term sustainability using data-driven decision-making, metrics review, and clear RAG-based program health reporting.
- Set the standard for program management excellence across the team, defining best practices for stakeholder management, executive communication, cross-functional coordination, and delivery rigor.
- Grow and develop program managers through development planning, coaching, and strategic program assignment;
- Identify and develop future program leaders through talent reviews and succession planning.
- Author narratives, operational plans, and strategic documentation that frame the team's delivery impact and organizational value and present to sr. leadership.
- Drive cost efficiencies and proactive risk mitigation across multiple concurrent programs before issues become roadblocks, escalating appropriately and ensuring the team delivers sustainably.

A day in the life
You will set the strategic direction for your team's program portfolio, making prioritization trade-offs and ensuring cross-functional alignment across diverse organizations. You will design governance mechanisms and operating cadences that give your team clear swim lanes and your leadership clear visibility into program health. During deployment seasons, you will coach your program managers through complex stakeholder negotiations and escalation decisions, capturing learnings into team-wide standards.

You will interact daily with diverse functional teams across multiple time zones and organizations - finance, operations, supply chain, engineering, and site selection. You will write effective narratives and present to Senior Managers and Directors, conducting regular meetings with internal teams, stakeholders, and vendors. You will build consensus on contentious prioritization decisions, communicate across an increasing diversity of areas (legal, regulatory, finance, operations), and provide the long-term perspective behind business and program choices. You will grow your program managers, run talent reviews, and ensure your team delivers results sustainably. No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for professional growth as part of a collaborative, focused team.

About the team
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon's leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfillment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

Amazon Ads is seeking an experienced technical leader to join our Services organization as a Manager of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants, based in London. In this role, you'll lead a team of Technical Enablers supporting Amazon's largest advertisers and agencies across the EU market. You'll be responsible for building and scaling post-sales technical support capabilities, driving innovation in customer solutions, and ensuring your team delivers exceptional service quality to our enterprise customers.

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

As a manager, you will oversee a critical portion of our technical DSP Services team, which works with enterprise agency and advertiser customers. You will manage a team of Technical Programmatic Solutions Consultants with expertise in advertising technology, programmatic advertising, and the Amazon DSP, who are leveraging this expertise to resolve a wide range of technical issues for our customers. Your team provides services ranging from custom training programs, to product and campaign strategy sessions, to technical troubleshooting. We help our customers understand how to integrate our technology into their workflow, driving self-sufficiency within the Amazon DSP.

You have experience managing a team and are able to work and inspire directly and indirectly across the EU and WW teams. You have a great track record of delivering complex projects and have impressed your stakeholders at all levels with your ability to communicate both written and verbally. You have demonstrated problem-solving capabilities across both technical and non-technical teams. The right candidate also possesses strong analytical acumen and is comfortable drawing metric-based conclusions by managing an extensive amount of data. You stay on top of industry and competitive trends, and you are able to execute at both a tactical and strategic level to drive customer satisfaction.

Key job responsibilities
- Navigate a high level of ambiguity. You love whitespace, and treat this space as your own company. You identify key business problems to prioritize then present the solutions to solve them on behalf of the business.
- Take ownership of managing a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants - Technical, including resource planning and driving success for the team’s customer category, possessing a complete understanding of internal and external variables that impact the business
- Work tactically and strategically. Determines the right strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome of the assigned category
- Be comfortable working with data to develop new opportunity areas, track program metrics, and use findings to influence business decisions
- Set goals and direction for the team, ensuring alignment with broader business goals and vision
- Hire, develop, and lead a team of Programmatic Solutions Consultants - Technical
- Thrive on technology and data and have expertise in monitoring and managing a services organization to maximum efficiency, productivity, and quality.
- Generate and implement big ideas to drive business improvement, innovation, and scale within the team and across the business as a whole. Lead cross functional collaboration to get big ideas implemented.
- Anticipate bottlenecks, assess risks, mitigate issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs
- Have strong communication and written skills and experience working across diverse stakeholder groups
- Represent Amazon when meeting with senior executive teams from top customers and build long term strategic relationships

A day in the life
* Lead and develop a team of Technical Enablers who resolve complex campaign execution issues and blockers for enterprise customers, particularly programmatic trading desks
* Drive operational excellence in technical issue resolution, ensuring your team provides knowledgeable and responsive support across our DSP product and processes
* Establish and optimize processes for issue investigation, including identifying campaign configuration and software defects, reproducing complex cases, and researching solutions
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to influence roadmaps based on customer feedback and technical insights derived from your team's interactions
* Develop and implement strategies to scale service quality, including the creation of tools and automation initiatives
* Own relationships with key stakeholders Services, Product teams, and Support Engineering
* Define and track success metrics around handling time, time to resolution, and service quality
* Build mechanisms to scale knowledge across the organization and enable first-line support teams
* Provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of customer incidents
* Ensure your team maintains the high customer service bar set by Amazon, recognizing that our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers

Please be aware that this role requires a commitment of 32 hours per week.

Location: Couldson

Operations is the heart and soul of everything Amazon does. It is thanks to effective operations that items are processed and dispatched to our customers on time. Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Quick Commerce (QC) delivers ultra-fast convenience through our network of small warehouse in city center locations, partnering with last-mile delivery providers to get products to customers in 30 minutes or less. We combine creative thinking and technological innovation to fulfill millions of urgent shopping missions, offering a curated selection of grocery items and Amazon essentials.
Our operations have two key components. Our 'under the roof' associates process orders with industry-leading speed, picking and packing customer orders to enable our 30-minute delivery promise. We operate with a people-first approach, with teams working across morning and afternoon shifts to serve customers seven days a week.
Meanwhile, our 'on the road' delivery network primarily utilizes Amazon Flex delivery partners on e-bikes specially optimized for rapid urban delivery. We continuously innovate to improve customer experience, focusing on sustainable delivery solutions in dense urban areas while maintaining strict quality and food safety standards.
Our team combines the best of Amazon's retail and logistics expertise, leveraging both Fresh and AMZL operational excellence. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous improvement, as we work to revolutionize convenience shopping through ultra-fast delivery.

Being an Operations Lead/Supervisor gives you the chance to see how all the different parts of operations work and play a role in making sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll be the first point of contact for team members during their shift and help them follow the processes that your managers have put in place. This is a hands-on role, which will give you experience in using the tools and systems that make our operations successful.

Key job responsibilities
Measure and monitor workflows, track onsite performance, and provide important shift information to frontline management to ensure operational excellence across shifts
Support and train employees to deliver great service and supervise them in their daily tasks
Support the Shift/Area Manager with projects to improve processes, cultivate a safe working environment, and increase workforce engagement
Work with other departments to find solutions to address common issues or support needs in areas of key performance
Use data analysis to identify ways to optimise safety, quality and productivity

A day in the life
As an Operations Lead/Supervisor, you’ll be based in one of our operational sites. You’ll support your Shift/Area Manager to carry out the plan for the shift. That will involve helping with pre-shift meetings with your team and monitoring procedures to make sure everyone is following safety rules, quality processes, and the priority plan for the day.

You’ll escalate any issues you spot to your manager, but sometimes you’ll be the most senior person on shift and will give people the direction they need to complete their tasks. At other times, you’ll support your Shift/Area Manager in planning shifts to make sure you have enough team members working during peak times.

About the team
Quick Commerce (QC) delivers ultra-fast convenience through our network of small warehouse in city center locations, partnering with last-mile delivery providers to get products to customers in 30 minutes or less. We combine creative thinking and technological innovation to fulfill millions of urgent shopping missions, offering a curated selection of grocery items and Amazon essentials.
Our operations have two key components. Our 'under the roof' associates process orders with industry-leading speed, picking and packing customer orders to enable our 30-minute delivery promise. We operate with a people-first approach, with teams working across morning and afternoon shifts to serve customers seven days a week.
Meanwhile, our 'on the road' delivery network primarily utilizes Amazon Flex delivery partners on e-bikes specially optimized for rapid urban delivery. We continuously innovate to improve customer experience, focusing on sustainable delivery solutions in dense urban areas while maintaining strict quality and food safety standards.
Our team combines the best of Amazon's retail and logistics expertise, leveraging both Fresh and AMZL operational excellence. We foster a collaborative environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous improvement, as we work to revolutionize convenience shopping through ultra-fast delivery.

This highly visible role will own engagement with customer C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, pan-Amazon, and other strategic relationships. You will demonstrate proficiency in business development, executing sales methodologies, bid management and managing CRM systems coupled with strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management abilities. - Leading business development efforts by engaging customers and driving multiple high-value engagements simultaneously
- Collaborating with Amazon Global Sales (AGS) representatives to Lead project planning, scheduling, and coordination to ensure timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
- Creating proposals, securing customer sign-off on Statements of Work (SOWs), and ensure successful project delivery

Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. Key job responsibilities

• Develop C-suite and line-of-business relationships with leading innovators within customer organizations
• Work with Sales leadership to identify and qualify customers for the Digital Innovation program

• Experience working within the technology industry is highly desired. Strong verbal and written communications skills are a must, as well as leadership skills

• 5+ years of business development, consulting, product management, or IT solutions development experience

Join the EMEA Go-to-Market Specialist Team to lead the GenAI transformation agenda across one of AWS's highest-growth and most strategic domains.

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS). We work backwards from our customers' most complex and business-critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist solutions architecture, and go-to-market.

This is a Principal-level GenAI GTM Specialist role responsible for driving enterprise Generative AI adoption across EMEA. Rather than owning a single service, you will own the cross-cutting GenAI transformation narrative — spanning Amazon Bedrock, agentic architectures, foundation model strategy, and emerging GenAI capabilities — and translate it into use-case-led motions that land measurable business outcomes in customers.

What We're Looking For
- Deep technical proficiency in Generative AI: foundation models, agentic patterns, and the Amazon Bedrock ecosystem.
- Demonstrated ability to land AI/ML transformation programmes in enterprise customers translating technology capability into business outcomes by use case.
- A blend of technical depth and commercial savvy equally comfortable whiteboarding a Think Big architecture and presenting an AI strategy to a C-suite.
- Experience building and executing GTM strategies at scale in a fast-moving technology domain.
Track record of operating as a thought leader and trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders.
- Ability to thrive in a high-ambiguity, high-velocity environment and shape direction without waiting for permission
- Data-driven approach to prioritization using pipeline data, propensity signals, and market intelligence to focus effort where it matters most
- Experience in enterprise technology sales, solutions architecture, or technical business development with a focus on AI/ML or cloud platforms
- Strong written and verbal communication able to author SLT-level narratives, field-facing plays, and customer-facing positioning with equal fluency

Key job responsibilities
- Own the EMEA GenAI GTM strategy end-to-end driving enterprise adoption of Amazon Bedrock and complementary GenAI services through use case led motion, define the narrative, identify high-impact use-case patterns.
- Land AI transformation in enterprises: develop and execute account-level GenAI strategies for priority industries, mapping business priorities to GenAI use cases, building transformation roadmaps, and guiding customers from proof-of-concept to production at scale.
- Operate at the CxO/VP and practitioner level: engage senior business leaders on AI strategy and value realisation while simultaneously working with developers, ML engineers, and architects on technical solution design and adoption patterns.
- Build and execute scaled GTM programmes : design motions including customer roundtables, GenAI workload assessments, use-case workshops, developer engagement, and regional campaigns that create demand and accelerate adoption.
- Thought Leadership : Create packaged deliverables (propensity models, use-case frameworks) and drive enablement that raises the bar across the EMEA field.
- Be the voice of EMEA customers to Product: synthesise regional customer requirements, competitive signals, and adoption blockers into actionable feedback that shapes Amazon Bedrock and GenAI service roadmaps.
- Influence Marketing: co-develop thought leadership, digital campaigns, and customer success stories that position AWS as the platform of choice for enterprise GenAI transformation.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across Specialist, Field, Partner, and Marketing teams to ensure consistent messaging and coordinated execution

A day in the life
You will lead the go-to-market strategy for one of the most exciting and high-growth domains in cloud. No two days are the same. You might start your morning on a deep-dive with a Fortune 500 financial services CTO mapping their enterprise-wide GenAI transformation roadmap — identifying the highest-value use cases, from intelligent document processing to autonomous customer service agents. After lunch, you're running a use-case workshop with a major retailer's engineering team, helping them see how Amazon Bedrock can power their next-generation product discovery experience and building the business case to take to their board. Later, you're jumping into a pipeline review with an Area AI/ML sales leader to pressure-test which opportunities are ready to move from pilot to production, before briefing a product team on what EMEA customers need next from Bedrock based on patterns you're seeing across dozens of enterprise engagements.

You'll collaborate daily with account teams, solution architects, partner managers, and AWS service teams — connecting the dots between customer business priorities, GenAI technical capabilities, and market opportunity. Your job is to make the complex simple: translating the art of the possible in Generative AI into concrete, use-case-led transformation programmes that customers can execute and measure. You operate as the connective tissue between what AWS builds and how enterprises adopt it at scale.

About the team
The EMEA WWSO AI/ML Geo Specialist team within AWS's Worldwide Specialist Organization owns and executes go-to-market strategy for the full portfolio of AWS AI/ML services. We serve customers across the complete AI lifecycle while also leading the way to drive net new innovative use cases in this domain. Our customers include some of the most technically sophisticated organizations in the world, and our work directly impacts how AI is built and deployed across EMEA.
You will join a team of passionate builders who combine deep technical curiosity with commercial acumen. We operate with a startup mentality inside one of the world's largest technology companies—moving fast, experimenting boldly, and holding ourselves to the highest standards.

target_jobs.description:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want to define the next
generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and
movies — all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business — available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.

Hundreds of millions of customers open Prime Video every week. They trust us to help them find something great to watch. Increasingly, they expect us to help them discover title offers, channel and bundle subscriptions that match their interests.

Today, we break that trust in small but compounding ways. A customer declines an offer and sees it again minutes later. A new subscriber gets upsells before finding a show they love. A loyal viewer showing signs of leaving receives a generic message that ignores everything they have ever watched.

We are hiring a Principal PMT to own Commerce Personalization for Prime Video. You will build the intelligence that makes every commerce interaction feel like it comes from a service that actually knows you.

This is a build-and-scale role. You will define what "right offer, right moment, right customer" means at Prime Video scale. You will ship systems that remember what customers have told us, respect their journey stage, and earn the right to make a recommendation. You will prove — through measurable customer outcomes — that respecting customer drives better business results than pressuring them.

Key job responsibilities
Own the customer problem end-to-end. Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Commerce Personalization across all Prime Video surfaces — homepage, detail pages, checkout, notifications, and partner storefronts.

Eliminate the contradictions customers experience today. Build coordinated intelligence, so a declined offer stays declined, at-risk customers get content before commerce, and new subscribers aren't treated like conversion targets. Define how we measure success and how it impacts our long-term success.

Crack problems others haven't, drive adoption at scale enabling Partner content discovery for the growing number of channels across 30+ countries. Personalized offer timing that converts because it's welcome

Ship fast, prove impact continuously. Start with the most painful customer contradiction and fix it. Every phase delivers measurable improvement — reduced repetition, better timing, higher engagement among at-risk segments. Build conviction through results.

Work backward from customers to technology. Partner with Applied Science and ML Engineering on reinforcement learning, multi-objective optimization, and unified customer representations — always in service of a specific customer outcome.

Drive organizational alignment. Get multiple teams to optimize shared customer outcomes over local metrics. Win this argument with evidence, not authority.

About the team
PV Commerce Personalization & Member Experience sits at the intersection of Prime Video's content experience and its commerce engine. We own the models, systems, and product experiences that determine which customers see which offers, when, and how. Our production models — including offer propensity, churn prediction, subscription ranking, and cross-offer optimization — serve decisions across every Prime Video commerce surface. We are evolving from siloed model optimization to a unified system that coordinates across the full customer journey. We are a product development team that partners closely with cross-functional teams across Prime Video to deliver customer and partner value.

You will proactively engage with emerging technology players to assess new trends, forge high-value collaborations, and structure creative commercial agreements that extend and enhance the overall advertising ecosystem. You are comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, enterprise sales, and platform strategy. You bring deep fluency in the EMEA ad space, a track record of structuring complex multi-party agreements across borders, and the ability to translate regional dynamics — from regulatory headwinds to emerging media consumption patterns — into actionable partnership frameworks that deliver measurable business impact.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) is a rapidly growing, global operation unit, which significantly impacts the customer experience. Within ATS, Amazon Freight Partner (AFP) is a program that enables entrepreneurs to start and grow their trucking business alongside Amazon, with exclusive and customized learning, ability to hire from their local communities, and long-term growth potential. It’s also the preferred supply type to launch and trial new technology such as Zero Emission Vehicles (ZEV).

The Amazon Freight Partner team is seeking candidates with entrepreneurial spirit who are quick learners and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment. We are looking for a Program Manager to help us to continue spearheading the electrification of the worldwide Amazon Middle Mile. You will contribute to the Amazon Climate pledge – our commitment made in 2019 to reach net-zero carbon emissions by 2040.

As key member of a cross functional and global team you will 1) Lead the ZEV weekly business review to drive and continuously improve operations of the existing BET fleet, 2) Manage deployment of new ZEVs across Europe, 3) Build business cases for strategic initiatives, 4) Coordinate due diligence on cross-business collaborations ensuring financial/operational viability and high carrier experience, 5) Influence and build the strategic BET expansion roadmap.

We are actively seeking a data and technology driven innovator, problem solver, comfortable solving ambiguous problems and focused on delighting our customers. You must have experience and be comfortable working with teams across all levels of different organizations.

This role offers an opportunity to make business-critical decisions that will transform the current transportation environment while influencing Senior Leadership on the direction for the Middle Mile business.

Some occasional domestic and international travel required (<10%).

Key job responsibilities
- Own the BET WBR and design/monitor metrics tracking BET fleet growth and operational health
- Contribute to the BET expansion strategy and define the deployment roadmap with cross-functional partners
- Support AFP carriers through vehicle deployment and overcoming payment/operational disparities
- Orchestrate driver type changes for the electric fleet to boost efficiency and achieve diesel TCO parity
- Manage the transition towards a variable consumption-based payment working with 3P vendors, Tax, Accounting, FinOps, and Finance)
- Monitor project execution and customer feedback to ensure quality delivery on target

About the team
Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the Amazon Transportation Service (ATS) team. As part of ATS, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centers equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.

We put safety first as our people are our priority, and we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

#TECHNOLOGY #SUSTAINABILITY #TRANSPORT #MIDDLEMILE #ZEROEMISSION #CLIMATEPLEDGE #FASTFORWARD
