We are seeking an experienced French and English-speaking Program Manager to lead, streamline, and elevate our processes and drive program improvement and optimization within the Amazon Last Mile Expansion business in EU. This role requires a program manager who can not only manage but also innovate and strategize at a high level. The Program Manager will leverage their extensive experience with data analytics to automate our processes, significantly increase our efficiency, and enable us to deliver larger-scale results.

The Amazon Last Mile Expansion program is a new model designed to enable Amazon to support speed initiatives and on-demand capacity in the EU. This program is powered by a sophisticated mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems, allowing operators to onboard, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more. The approach and technology are disruptive and promise to challenge traditional approaches, potentially revolutionizing industry operations.

The successful candidate will be experienced in program management and optimization. They will be self-motivated, passionate, analytically proficient, and detail-oriented, possessing superior interpersonal and communication skills. The ideal Program Manager will be comfortable working independently to drive growth and change in a fast-paced environment, leveraging their extensive background to make high-impact decisions.

A strong bias for action and a deep comfort with complex data analysis are absolute musts for this role. Candidates must demonstrate a track record of delivering results, with examples of successfully leading high-impact projects. The ability to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) based tools, and Large Language Models (LLMs) are a must in this role.

Key job responsibilities
- Find opportunities to automate and optimize existing Last Mile processes. This includes, but not limited to, our under the roof processes and on road processes.

- You will partner with the Amazon Logistics operations and central strategy teams to deploy program, process and station improvements. Another part of the role will be recommending changes and using your project management and stakeholder management skills to put new processes in place.

- Partner with WW Flex / Last Mile teams to understand common challenges to adopt standard practice and identify opportunities to collaborate with tech teams to build automated tooling and solutions to hand off our processes.

- Support the expansion of the Last Mile Speed program across EU through extension of existing processes, and creation of new ones where applicable.

A day in the life
As a Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programmes. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.

Program Managers have important responsibilities, and you’ll deal with complex challenges with creativity, innovation, and leadership. With a responsibility extending beyond process improvements, you could also contribute to improving other areas of the business, like diversity, equity, and inclusion.

target_jobs.description:
Would you like to help the organisations that fund and enable UK science get more from the cloud?

The UK’s central research bodies — UKRI and its Research Councils (EPSRC, MRC, BBSRC, NERC, STFC, AHRC, ESRC), the Wellcome Trust, NIHR, the Royal Society, the British Academy, and national research facilities — collectively invest billions of pounds each year in science and innovation. They fund researchers, operate world-class facilities (from the Diamond Light Source to the Hartree Centre), define data and computing strategies for entire disciplines, and set the policy frameworks that shape how research infrastructure is provisioned across the UK. Increasingly, cloud is central to their plans.

The government has committed £1 billion to expand AI compute capacity 20× by 2030 through the AI Research Resource (AIRR). UKRI’s £129 million Digital Research Infrastructure programme is building a connected national fabric of compute, data, and skills. STFC operates national HPC services, Jisc provides shared digital infrastructure to the sector, and the Wellcome Trust is investing heavily in open data platforms and Trusted Research Environments. These organisations are not just users of technology — they are the architects of the UK’s research computing future. AWS wants to be their partner of choice.

Amazon Web Services is seeking an Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of UK central research bodies. You will be the primary commercial relationship owner for your assigned accounts — responsible for driving revenue, building pipeline, and positioning AWS as the infrastructure platform that accelerates national research outcomes. This is not about selling to individual researchers — it’s about engaging the organisations that set strategy, allocate funding, and operate shared services for the entire UK research ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will understand how public-sector funding bodies and national research organisations operate — their governance structures, procurement frameworks, strategic planning cycles, and stakeholder landscapes. They should be comfortable engaging at senior executive level (CEO, COO, CIO, Director of Digital) while also building relationships with technical leaders responsible for national platforms and services. A background in public sector, research, or science and innovation policy would be a strong advantage.

Key Job Responsibilities

Own and manage a defined portfolio of UK central research bodies (e.g. UKRI, STFC, EPSRC, MRC, BBSRC, NERC, Wellcome Trust, NIHR, Jisc, national research facilities), driving revenue growth and AWS adoption.

Develop and execute comprehensive account plans aligned to each organisation’s strategic priorities — covering national research infrastructure, data platforms, AI compute, shared services, and cloud-first policy initiatives.

Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers: Chief Executives, Chief Operating Officers, CIOs, Directors of Digital, Heads of Research Infrastructure, and Procurement Directors.

Understand and navigate the unique funding, governance, and procurement structures of public research bodies — including UKRI framework agreements, Wellcome Trust investment governance, and government spending controls.

Identify and qualify new opportunities across national HPC services, research data platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, Trusted Research Environments, shared cloud services, and digital transformation programmes.

Maintain a robust and accurate sales pipeline with clear next steps, timely CRM updates, and reliable forecasting.

Create and articulate compelling value propositions that connect AWS capabilities to national research outcomes — accelerating science, improving data sharing, enabling open research, and reducing operational cost.

Navigate long, complex procurement cycles involving multiple governance layers, ministerial approvals, and framework compliance (e.g. G-Cloud, CCS, JANET).

Work with AWS Solution Architects, Specialist teams (HPC, AI/ML, Analytics, Storage, Security), Partners, and Professional Services to deliver technical validation and proof-of-value engagements.

Engage with AWS policy and government affairs teams to align account strategies with broader UK government technology and research policy.

Represent AWS at sector events to build relationships and generate demand.

Track and report on pipeline, revenue, and adoption KPIs; participate in QBRs and business reviews.

About the team
The AWS UK Education team is part of UK Public Sector within Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS). We work with universities, research bodies, colleges, and education technology companies across the UK to help them innovate, reduce costs, and deliver better outcomes for students and researchers. Our team combines deep sector expertise with technical credibility — we understand how the UK research ecosystem is funded, governed, and operated, and we meet our customers where they are on their cloud journey.

As the Risk Manager for High Severity Intelligence (HSI), you will provide world-class empathetic experiences to support internal and external stakeholders after an incident. In this role, you will deep dive incidents, driving accountability across the organization and generating insights that will mitigate risk and improve safety programs.

This is a large-scale, rapid response coordination program designed to ensure timely and thorough management of the highest severity incidents that affect any of our Last Mile transporters, customers, or community members. We investigate and handle the most sensitive of tragedies with professionalism and care, and coordinate the process of response through thoughtful communication with all involved, including the most senior leaders at Amazon. You will be responsible for the experience of our customers and community members during some of the hardest moments of their lives.

A successful candidate will possess high emotional intelligence and the capacity to provide support in emotionally charged situations. This includes the ability to remain composed, empathetic, and supportive when dealing with individuals affected by a tragic incident. The candidate should embrace ambiguity and drive clarity across teams and organizations. This role requires strong relationship building skills and sound business judgment. They will be an excellent communicator, verbally and through writing, enabling them to work successfully with diverse audiences. Balancing time between projects and rapid response is a critical component for success in the position. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytic skills, and leadership are essential to success in this role.

This role participates in on-call rotation. Experience in crisis management, incident response, or a related field is preferred.

Key job responsibilities
- Participate in on-call rotation, leading incident response activities within the region,
- Own incident investigation end-to-end, identifying contributing factors and recommending risk mitigations,
- Align with key stakeholders and Legal to ensure incident response and risk mitigation actions meet regulatory and compliance requirements,
- Optimise existing workflows and processes for incident response, identifying improvements to drive team effectiveness in an evolving legal and regulatory landscape,
- Own risk programs, driving execution and measuring outcomes against team goals,
- Measure and track program effectiveness within your workstream, surfacing insights and recommendations to leadership,
- Prepare clear incident reports, COEs, and briefing documentation used by senior leaders,
- Communicate proactively with internal stakeholders, negotiating priorities and clarifying what success looks like.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
- High emotional intelligence and the capacity to remain composed, empathetic, and supportive in sensitive and emotionally charged situations,
- Ability to work in ambiguous situations within a defined framework, designing short-term solutions with limited guidance,
- Clear and concise verbal and written communication (e.g., incident reports, COEs, MBR/QBR inputs), with the ability to facilitate dialogue and foster shared understanding,
- Effective time management and the ability to make trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- Sound judgement on when to act independently versus escalate complex or systemic issues,
- Strong documentation skills and ability to create plans, communicate requirements, and negotiate priorities across teams.

Additional requirements:
- Role requires up to 15% international travel
- Must be able to work flexibly across multiple time zones

You have a strong foundation in audit principles, as well as a diverse technology background. As part of the team, you will work with customers and regulators to demonstrate Amazon' security controls applicable to local requirements. You will join our team in helping customers understand how our infrastructure is designed, operated, maintained, and protected in accordance with global regulated industry standards.

You will help inspire, lead, and transform our audit and compliance programs through innovative process engineering across multiple organizations and teams, engaging technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the company. Your combination of technical and audit background will help bridge security, technology, and compliance, and facilitate the scale of the program.

The successful candidate is one who loves working across many stakeholders, including internal and external customers, to design solutions for complex compliance challenges. You are passionate about the security of the cloud and you want to solve real business problems.

We have a team culture that encourages ownership, diversity, inclusion, and innovation. We expect team members and management alike to take a high degree of ownership for their program vision and execution of ideas. We expect this person to balance their unique perspective with those of the diverse perspectives of the team and its stakeholders. You will have an opportunity to work directly with senior leadership within Amazon to improve our ability to demonstrate assurance for regulated customers.

You should be a technically experienced and innovative security, compliance, and audit professional who has the ability to understand IT processes, communicate clearly and transparently with customers, and to be able to drive innovative process changes through multiple organizations and teams.

Key job responsibilities
As part of the team, you will work with customers and regulators to demonstrate Amazon security controls applicable to local requirements. You will join our team in helping customers understand how our infrastructure is designed, operated, maintained, and protected in accordance with global regulated industry standards. In this role, you will be responsible for the following activities:
- Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to articulate compliance implications to both customers and internal/external audit functions.
- Develop understanding of regulated industry compliance requirements and communicate how we control activities to meet global regulatory obligations.
- Liaise with customers, regulators and auditors, articulate control implementation, and describe considerations for applying security and compliance concepts to monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve the organization by being a trusted advisor, facilitator and creative problem solver.

Diverse Experiences
AWS Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Security
At AWS, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of AWS’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a territory coverage plan aligned to national policing strategies.

To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

Experience building strategic relationships with stakeholders, including communicating and collaborating across teams and functions

Experience with pipeline management including utilisation of Salesforce or other CRM tools

Experience in account management, sales, or business development within policing, law enforcement, or public safety

Demonstrated experience working with UK police forces, the Home Office, NCA, College of Policing, or equivalent law enforcement bodies

A track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles typical of policing and public sector procurement

We’d love it if you also bring:

An understanding of the UK policing landscape, including funding models (Home Office grants, PCC precepts), national programmes, and digital transformation drivers

Familiarity with decision-making structures across policing — Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners, the NPCC, Home Office, CIOs, and procurement bodies

Awareness of sector challenges such as data-led policing, digital evidence management, cross-force interoperability, cloud migration, hybrid working, and operational efficiency

Knowledge of relevant procurement routes (Crown Commercial Service, BlueLight Commercial, G-Cloud, Digital Marketplace)

SC (Security Check) clearance or willingness to undergo clearance

The ability to navigate long, consensus-driven procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders across forces and national bodies

Experience developing account plans aligned to policing strategies (e.g. National Policing Digital Strategy, Policing Vision 2030, force-level digital transformation programmes)

The ability to articulate technology value propositions in the context of policing outcomes — operational efficiency, data-led decision making, and citizen safety

Key job responsibilities
Promote AWS services across a defined territory of UK policing accounts

Develop and execute a comprehensive account and territory plan aligned to national policing priorities (e.g. National Policing Digital Strategy, Policing Vision 2030)

Create and articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services in the context of policing outcomes — including data-led policing, digital evidence management, and interoperability

Facilitate customer adoption of AWS services, navigating complex multi-stakeholder and cross-force procurement processes

Maintain a robust projects pipeline across new and existing policing accounts

Work with partners, systems integrators, and ISVs to extend reach and promote adoption

Contribute to a positive customer experience and build long-term trusted relationships across the policing ecosystem

Engage at senior levels including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, CIOs, CTOs, and Home Office officials

A day in the life
As an Account Manager in the Policing territory, no two days are the same. You might start the morning preparing for a strategic engagement with a Regional Police leadership team on their cloud-first Digital Policing Platform programme, before joining a cross-functional working session with Solutions Architects and partners to shape a proposal for a next-generation intelligence and analytics capability.

Your internal stakeholders include Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Partner teams, and Specialist sales overlays. Your customers are senior technology and operational leaders within police forces, national law enforcement agencies, Police and Crime Commissioners’ offices. The problems you solve span infrastructure modernisation, secure data sharing across forces, digital evidence management, data-led operational policing, and enabling the sector’s ambition to deliver safer communities through technology.

About the team
Policing is one of the most meaningful verticals in UK Public Sector. The customers you’ll work with are on the front line of keeping people safe, and the technology decisions they make have real-world impact. You’ll be joining a team that cares deeply about getting this right — and you’ll have the backing of the entire AWS ecosystem to help you do it.

We offer a collaborative, high-trust environment where you’ll have genuine ownership of your accounts and the freedom to build your territory your way. If you want to do work that matters, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Senior Business Analyst within the Content Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as an analytical leader and trusted thought partner for our senior Content leadership team, as well as the primary analytics conduit for European Content teams. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving the analytical frameworks and reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization.

Working in complex and often ambiguous problem spaces, you'll transform multi-source data into clear, actionable recommendations that drive long-term strategy. Your deep expertise in the Content business — spanning audiobooks, physical books, and/or other digital media — will allow you to proactively anticipate leadership questions and surface insights before they're asked. As a content data SME, you'll help drive data quality standards within your domain while making insights readily accessible through efficient, scalable, self-service solutions.

ABOUT YOU
You are an analytical leader who balances technical expertise with deep business acumen, particularly within the world of content. You excel at working cross-functionally, translating complex business challenges into robust analytical frameworks and long-term solutions. You're naturally curious, with a talent for looking beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions driving our Content business forward.

You thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with strong judgment while continuously raising the bar on data processes and analytical best practices. Your communication skills are exceptional — you distill complex analyses into compelling, influential narratives for both technical and executive audiences. You build strong, trust-based relationships with stakeholders that position your insights to meaningfully influence business strategy and decision-making across the organization.

- Drive operational excellence and data governance by improving, streamlining, and/or eliminating excess processes; work with data owners to onboard new sources, guarantee data fidelity, and ensure consistency in metric definitions, documentation standards, and data quality

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Senior Engagement Manager (EM) to join our team and lead the delivery of complex cloud solution projects. In this role you will combine technical expertise with strong project leadership skills to drive successful implementations of AWS-based solutions for our clients. You will bridge business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating technical discussions and ensuring alignment with customer outcomes. Applying AWS frameworks like Well-Architected and Cloud Adoption Framework while demonstrating technical credibility across diverse stakeholders, you will distill customer needs into clear technical requirements, decompose complex problems, and make informed trade-off decisions considering performance, scalability, security, and business impact.

Possessing strong technology and program/project management experience, you will validate technical solutions against business goals, recognize when additional technical evaluation is needed, and manage technical risks. You will be expected to achieve and maintain relevant AWS certifications, develop domain-specific expertise, and effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and business audiences. As you progress, you’ll lead increasingly complex technical projects, shape cross-organizational technical strategies, and establish best practices in your domain. In this role you will apply your management and leadership capabilities to successfully execute project plans, proactively identify and manage risks, resolve issues, escalate when appropriate, and drive projects to successful completion, while exceeding customer expectations.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Eligibility for UK Government Security Clearance is required for this role (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels)

Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology program/project manager, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and managing complex cloud migration and transformation projects/programmes from inception to completion
• Ensuring successful delivery of project/programme outcomes within agreed time frames, budget and quality parameters
• Developing and executing project/programme level planning with the agility to adjust strategies as necessary to meet evolving business objectives
• Building and maintaining strong stakeholder relationships across customers, partners and internal teams at all levels
• Driving key decisions and resolving project/programme level risks and issues
• Establishing robust governance model, project/programme structure and communication plan
• Leading a multidisciplinary teams of technical specialists
• Ensuring compliance with security, regulatory and governance requirements
• Bridging business requirements with technical solutions, facilitating engineering discussions and ensuring alignment with customer business outcomes
• Distilling customer needs into clear technical requirements and map them to business outcomes


A day in the life
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer.
That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Shipping is reinventing how the UK's largest retailers get parcels to their customers, and we are looking for a driven, entrepreneurial Senior Enterprise Account Manager to own and grow relationships with some of our most important enterprise shippers.

This is a commercial role at heart. You will be the trusted partner to your customers, understanding their business, shaping the right strategy for each account, and driving growth in volume, revenue and profitability. Earning that trust takes more than a strong relationship: it takes a genuine grasp of what is happening inside the account. So while this is not a data role, the best people in it are comfortable in the numbers. You will be expected to dig into performance data, get to the real root cause of an issue rather than the symptom, and let evidence shape your recommendations and decisions.

You will thrive here if you are energised by a fast-moving, ever-changing environment where the playbook is often still being written. You will need to be comfortable with ambiguity, inventive when faced with unusual or difficult problems, and the kind of person who rolls up their sleeves to fix things for customers, including the unglamorous, behind-the-scenes work that no one will ever publicly credit you for. We measure ourselves on the outcomes we deliver for shippers, not on who gets the applause.

The successful candidate will pair strong commercial and relationship instincts with solid analytical judgement, and will work effectively across Business, Operations, Product, Finance, Tech and Procurement, both inside Amazon and inside the customer's organisation. You will operate largely independently, set the strategy for your accounts, and lead initiatives that improve how we serve your customers and customers across the wider business.


Key job responsibilities
• Own strategy, commercial growth and retention of a portfolio of large enterprise shippers, meeting and exceeding targets for volume, revenue, gross profit and margin.

• Earn and keep shippers' trust by recommending solutions that fit their needs and solving the operational and commercial problems in their way, including hands-on work behind the scenes.

• Build durable relationships across a diverse set of customer and internal stakeholders, up to senior management.

• Track customer performance, take the right actions, and report back to internal stakeholders at all levels.

• Use account performance data to understand what is really happening, articulate clear root-cause analysis, and link findings to specific, prioritised actions.

• Invent and simplify: develop original approaches where no established process exists, and improve the mechanisms the wider team relies on.

• Assess account and programme risks, anticipate challenges early, and own escalation end to end, finding a path forward when the situation is difficult.

• Advise customers on best practices to accelerate adoption of our products and reduce their cost and effort to ship with us.

• Translate customer needs and market signals into clear, well-evidenced requirements for internal Product and Operations teams, and advocate for the changes that matter most.



A day in the life
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning with a customer's commercial and logistics teams, shaping a growth plan to bring more of their volume onto Amazon Shipping. In the afternoon you could be diving into a dip in delivery performance, tracing it to source in the data and pulling in Operations to fix it before the customer raises it, then pressure-testing a pricing or volume scenario ahead of a business review. You set your priorities, decide where your time creates most value, and are trusted to deliver without being told how.

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who is excited to join a tech company that is constantly improving and re-imagining the logistics industry. Our candidate should be passionate about using data to solve big, complex, and ambiguous problems across end-to-end network design - spanning Inbound, Sortable, Non-Sort, Middle Mile, and Last Mile segments.
The ideal candidate should be eager to continuously learn and improve their skills, with a keen eye for the details that make all the difference. You will partner with network planning teams to drive financial governance, support multi-billion euro CapEx planning, and shape the topology decisions that define how we serve customers faster.
Do you want to contribute to shaping the future of logistics and the new standard of shopping? If so, come and join the Network Planning Finance team.

Key job responsibilities
- Independently identifies and drives cost-out opportunities across multiple network segments (Inbound, Sortable, Non-Sort, Middle Mile, Last Mile) by connecting operational performance metrics to financial outcomes, defining the analytical framework where one may not exist

- Navigates complex, ambiguous CapEx and network cost structures with limited or incomplete data, exercising senior judgement to size opportunities, quantify trade-offs, and recommend action to leadership with confidence

- Leads root cause analysis on systemic issues spanning multiple sites or topology decisions, uncovering underlying drivers and designing scalable measurement frameworks that raise the bar on network efficiency

- Serves as a trusted strategic partner to senior Network Planning leaders, proactively influencing decisions on investment, capacity placement, and network cost strategy rather than responding to requests

- Owns the end-to-end relationship with data source providers and technology teams, driving automation roadmaps, defining data quality standards, and ensuring decision-grade data is available at pace to support network design cycles

- Identifies and champions process improvements across the wider finance organization, codifying best practices, raising the analytical standard for peers and junior analysts

A day in the life
You will be at the heart of how Amazon's logistics network evolves. On any given day, you might be building the financial business case for a new site launch, modelling what happens to cost and service when a topology change is proposed, or presenting capacity investment trade-offs to Senior Leadership.
You will partner closely with Network Planning, Operations, and Technology teams to translate complex planning decisions into clear financial recommendations. One morning you could be quantifying the cost impact of adding a new node to the network; by the afternoon, you may be automating a reporting pipeline using AI tools to free up time for deeper analysis.
No two days look the same, but the thread that ties them together is this: you will use data, judgement, and financial rigor to help the business make better, faster decisions about where to invest, what to build, and how to design the network of the future.

About the team
As part of the End-to-end Network Design Finance team, you will join a team that is passionate about numbers, data, and how to use them to generate insights and improve our business. We support and influence the organization by providing a holistic and financial perspective, we are the trusted business advisors. We collaborate with our partners to ensure leaders have the most up to date and reliable information, and work with them to make sure we are making the best possible decisions.

We are trusted business advisors: we bring a holistic financial perspective and partner with the business to make the best possible decisions.

Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. From a team of booksellers, CF has scaled into a sophisticated global network that handles millions of orders every day. Our Fulfilment Centres are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced operations — often called the “First Mile” because it is where most Amazon packages begin their journey.
As CF Finance, we work closely with our Operations partners to ensure leaders have reliable, up-to-date information to take the right decisions. We value the different perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets our people bring — they make us stronger.

• Build reports and financial models that inform forecasting, planning and problem-solving, and share your analysis to support strategic decisions.
• Dive deep to understand what is driving performance, identify root causes behind variances, and propose actionable recommendations.
• Own recurring financial and operational reporting, ensuring accuracy and providing clear, timely commentary to stakeholders.
• Build trusted relationships with business partners, use narratives, data and analysis to influence decisions, and challenge assumptions where the data tells a different story.
• Lead or contribute to projects that scale processes, strengthen controllership, or add value.
• Simplify and improve: automate processes, reduce defects, and make your deliverables easier for everyone to use.
• Communicate findings clearly and concisely — both verbally and in writing — including to non-finance partners and senior leaders, even as topics grow more complex.
• Contribute to the team by building and maintaining tools, SOPs and documentation, sharing knowledge with others, and supporting the onboarding and development of colleagues.


A day in the life
You use data to build reports and financial models that answer difficult business questions. You dive into cost drivers and productivity metrics, and when performance moves away from plan, you look for the story behind the numbers. You sit side by side with your Operations partners, translating data into clear, actionable insight and aligning on the right path forward.

You work independently on your own analysis while partnering closely with colleagues across the business. You will be based in one of our corporate offices and may visit our sites from time to time to ground your analysis in real operational context. No two weeks look exactly the same, and that variety is part of what makes the role rewarding.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon is seeking an Indirect Tax Senior Manager to join the EMEA Digital and Devices Tax team in London, supporting the launch and growth of Amazon Leo's consumer business across Europe.
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low earth orbit satellite network, with a mission to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities beyond the reach of existing networks (https://leo.amazon.com/gb/en/). As Leo launches its consumer offering across EMEA, the successful candidate will lead the indirect tax position for the B2C business, working closely with Business, Engineering, Finance, Legal and external advisors to shape the tax treatment of Leo’s new consumer service from the outset.
The role will offer exposure to a broad range of jurisdictions and technical topics, including telecommunications services, bundled offerings of connectivity and hardware, design of consumer billing systems, place of supply for cross-border flows, and the interaction between indirect tax, direct tax, transfer pricing and accounting. There will also be scope for engagement with local tax authorities through enquiries and audits as they arise.


Key job responsibilities
The role provides indirect tax advisory support to the Amazon Leo consumer business across EMEA, covering the Leo satellite internet service, associated consumer hardware, and bundled or promotional offerings sold to consumers.
The role involves:
1. Leading the indirect tax position for the Leo consumer launch across EMEA, from strategy through go-live and into steady-state operation.
2. Advising on new features and product changes, including bundling of connectivity with hardware and other services.
3. Partnering with Leo business teams early in the product development cycle to ensure tax considerations are reflected in business requirements documents.
4. Working with Engineering to translate tax requirements into system logic, resolving open points and driving the testing approach to ensure a compliant launch.
5. Advising on customer-facing outputs, including invoicing, billing system design, pricing displays and customer communications.
6. Managing external advisors: setting the scope of advice, independently evaluating the output and reaching a sound position.
7. Handling engagement with tax authorities across EMEA, including audits, enquiries and informal engagement, in coordination with compliance colleagues.
8. Providing technical direction to more junior colleagues supporting the business line.
The role is primarily advisory, working closely with compliance colleagues on registrations, returns, audits and process improvements.

A day in the life
The role typically involves moving between three types of work. Advisory work with Product and Engineering on features under development, ensuring that tax treatment is understood, agreed and implemented before launch. Ongoing support for the live business, including advisor queries, positions to be documented, and questions raised by Finance or Legal. Ad-hoc work, including engagement with tax authorities, review of legislative changes across EMEA, and support for wider planning work across the digital services and consumer devices portfolio where relevant.

About the team
The team supports Amazon's digital services and consumer devices businesses across EMEA. The team advises a portfolio of businesses covering streaming (Prime Video, Amazon MGM Studios, Amazon Music), digital content (Kindle, Audible), connected devices (Alexa, Ring) and now satellite broadband, and works directly with business teams and cross-functional stakeholders including accounting, legal, finance and tax. The team's focus is on providing clear, commercial and robust tax positions that allow the business to move forward with confidence, and on engaging early in the product development cycle to ensure tax outcomes are delivered at launch.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon’s Accounting department is looking for a talented Senior Program Manager to support our VAT (Value-Added Tax) Account Health team. In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs spanning multiple VP-level organizations and 12+ countries. You will operate with significant autonomy while navigating competing priorities to drive cohesive global strategies. Acting as a strategic Senior Program Manager, you will serve as the connective tissue between Tax, Accounting, Finance Operations, and FinTech, influencing outcomes through data-driven insights and stakeholder alignment rather than direct authority. This position requires managing stakeholder relationships, orchestrating cross-organizational governance structures, and delivering measurable improvements to VAT account health. You will work in a fast-paced environment, drive clarity through ambiguity, and lead multiple simultaneous initiatives impacting global operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead global programs to improve indirect tax account health, including development of VP-level goals, KPI frameworks, and strategic roadmaps
- Drive cross-functional working groups spanning Accounting, Indirect Tax Compliance, Finance Operations, Global Tax Data Services, and FinTech
- Develop and implement standardized operating procedures (SOPs) for VAT account management across global teams, driving adoption across 100+ stakeholders
- Build governance structures that create clear accountability, eliminate silos, and accelerate decision-making across disparate organizations
- Identify, quantify, and communicate organizational risks to senior leadership with clear recommendations for resolution or mitigation
- Drive alignment among competing priorities across multiple time zones and business units through influence, transparency, and strategic escalation
- Develop data-driven reporting and dashboards that provide actionable insights to leadership for decision-making
- Lead root-cause analysis of reconciling items and implement scalable mechanisms to address systemic defects
- Create and maintain program mechanisms (e.g., weekly updates, bi-weekly leadership reviews, working group forums) to drive stakeholder engagement and progress visibility
- Manage program transitions and stabilization efforts, quickly diagnosing organizational friction points and implementing practical solutions

About the team
The VAT (Value-Added Tax) Health Group is the centralized program management function responsible for driving VAT account health and controllership across Amazon's global operations. The team sets strategy, establishes mechanisms, and drives execution of initiatives that improve VAT account reconciliation, standardize processes, and strengthen controllership across Accounting, Tax, Finance Operations, and FinTech organizations.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services is a dynamic and rapidly growing business within Amazon.com. We provide a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. We provide organisations with building block web services that allow them to innovate faster and operate their software more cost-effectively. These services-in-the-cloud include on-demand compute capacity, storage, content delivery, querying of structured data, message queuing, and more. The AWS team is building and delivering the next generation of cloud computing that supports public AWS offerings like S3, EC2, and CloudFront. We are innovating new ways of building massively scalable distributed systems.

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. At AWS' scale, we invent new ways to provide the highest level of assurance to our security conscious customers. AWS Security is looking for a Senior Security Assurance Lead who can prioritize well, communicate early and clearly, and has a solid understanding of security and compliance within a cloud environment.

The Senior Security Assurance Lead will lead AWS Service Assurance activity and be part of the team which is responsible for demonstrating the security controls of services offered by AWS to our customer. This position will be focused on the Service Assurance function, leading on day-to-day security assurance activities, evaluating compliance and providing evidence of how they meet the requirements of our most security conscious customers, whilst developing strategies and mechanisms for how these processes can be completed as seamlessly and effectively as possible.

At AWS we are obsessed with earning and maintaining customer trust. This role facilitates our ability to build and maintain that trust through our internal Security Assurance processes and mechanisms. Ideal candidates will have the ability to learn and comprehend security control implementations and operational effectiveness, AWS services, and IT and cloud auditing processes. They will also be able to evaluate opportunities for improvement, and influence across organizations and teams.

You will be expected to review existing processes and think big to establish long-term strategic mechanisms.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate with internal teams and customers to establish baselines and agree the security requirements and associated security controls.
• Manage requests for evidence relating to key security controls, by working in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
• Responsible for reviewing the security of proposed new AWS systems, networks, and software designs for potential system security risks, and resolving integration issues related to the implementation of new services within the existing cloud infrastructure.
• Liaise between key stakeholders and AWS technical communities to articulate security control implementation.
• Dive deep into the Amazon control environment to develop broad domain and technical understanding of our security activities and control implementations to enable these to be articulated to both customers and internal/external stakeholders.
• Work across a wide variety of AWS teams to establish and maintain information security documentation.

About the team
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

About the team
About Amazon Security

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

About the team

You'll be part of the WWSO Startup team, where you will be a Technical Business Developer that helps start-ups adopt AWS’ technologies with a focus on PhysicalAI and GenAI, among others. The WWSO (Worldwide Specialist Organization) helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies, sitting in the sweet-spot between product teams, account sales teams and customer success roles. target_jobs.description:
Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth’s most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.

Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, an Execution Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network.
You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.


Key job responsibilities
- Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements
- Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels
- Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain
- Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience
- Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity
- Provide analytical deep dives and models to better guide network execution and strategy


About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

The CF team are the first people in the chain that helps customers get products at the speed we’re known for. We’re based in Fulfilment Centres, which are at the heart of Amazon’s fast-paced Operations network. Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to some of the world's largest financial services organizations.

The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager who possesses stakeholder management, program management, and well-rounded technical capabilities. You will drive the execution of complex, cross-organizational programs that protect advertiser trust at scale - including vendor integrations, enhancing capabilities across evolving supply types such as CTV, audio and gaming. You will work across multiple teams with evolving priorities, define clarity where ambiguity exists, and make trade-offs to drive program delivery. As a Sr. TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints. Program Execution & Delivery

- Own delivery of cross-organizational initiatives
- Define program milestones, manage dependencies across all stakeholders, and drive teams to deliver on commitments
Technical Depth & Architecture Influence
- Understand the real-time ad serving infrastructure
- Evaluate technical proposals, identify risks in system design, and ensure appropriate trade-offs.
- Drive technical integration programs with third-party vendors.
- Partner with science teams on ML model deployment experimentation frameworks, and signal validation.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-Org Alignment
- Manage relationships and alignment across senior leaders and stakeholders
- Drive executive communications through monthly and quarterly updates, and escalate to leadership effectively as needed.
- Navigate competing priorities across advertiser protection, publisher relationships, and business growth imperatives
- Represent Brand Safety programs in cross-org forums
Operational Excellence
- Create mechanisms that ensure long-term program success with or without direct involvement — documentation, runbooks, audit trails
- Own program-level metrics and reporting for leadership visibility

A day in the life
You will work with cross functional stakeholders across engineering, product and data science leadership to define engineering and product strategy. You will deliver state of the art machine learning based technical solutions that will power several contextual advertising products across Amazon Ads.

Amazon is seeking a Indirect Tax Senior Manager to join the EMEA Tax Department based in London or in Luxembourg to support the Amazon Web Services (“AWS”) cloud computing business, focusing on VAT advisory.

The ideal candidate will be able to work with a high level of collegiality and independence, supporting AWS as it expands in EMEA and an increasing number of countries introduce legislation to bring within the scope of VAT supplies of “Electronically Supplied Services” or “Digital Services” rendered by non-residents.

Advising the AWS business will allow the candidate to be exposed to many jurisdictions in EMEA, as well as a variety of topics, including ESS, telecommunications, training, movements of goods, due diligence relating to acquisitions, launch of new products, etc. There will also be scope for dealing with local tax authorities through “horizontal monitoring” relationships, ad-hoc enquiries and during audits. The AWS Tax Team also works closely with tax authorities by participating to public consultations and workshops about new laws.


This role can be filled in London or Luxembourg.



Key job responsibilities
The role is to provide Indirect Tax support to the AWS Business Unit in EMEA. This includes primarily the AWS branded services (Cloud + Marketplace – www.aws.amazon.com). It also covers other entities within the “AWS Group”, such as Annapurna Labs, the AI chips designer.

The role will not focus solely on products / services sold by AWS and associated entities. We also advise on billing systems and supply chains, especially in relation to the AWS infrastructure (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/), which forms the back-bone of the business – this includes the Data Centers and Points of Presence (known as “PoP”) Sites in EMEA (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/global-infrastructure/regions_az/?p=ngi&loc=2), as well as the sustainability effort (https://aws.amazon.com/about-aws/sustainability/).

The role involves:
1) Providing advice on new ventures and new products
2) Driving the tax requirements for AWS’ geographic expansion
3) Helping business find new solutions to problems raised / pain points by customers
4) Pro-actively communicating to business changes in law or new opportunities
5) Considering all aspects of business: Pricing, User Interface, Billing, Communication, FAQs, etc.
6) Supporting the supply infrastructure supply chain, from chips design, to server rack installation
7) Participating in public consultations on policy, including e-invoicing, to help shape the future of indirect taxation

The work by the team is very broad and allocation of projects is fluid: there are owners, but the team works together, to ensure good balance of workload and that all team members can see all areas of the business (instead of just “specializing” in one). The owner will not be required to “know it all”, but to drive the project and seek help/support from the team and other stakeholders (including outside advisers). The role will involve a wide geography exposure and broad range of offering:

1) AWS currently has a presence in over 40 countries in EMEA and keeps expanding
2) AWS is involved in Cloud Services, but also tangible goods (Data Centres) and hybrid offerings.

The role is 100% advisory: there is no compliance. However, we work closely with our compliance colleagues to support tax registrations, high-level review of tax returns, relationship with Tax Authorities, Management of Audits, internal reviews, process improvements, and training.


About the team
AWS offers a broad set of global cloud-based products including compute, storage, databases, analytics, networking, mobile, developer tools, management tools, Internet of Things, security and enterprise applications. These services help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale. AWS is trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads including: web and mobile applications, game development, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others. AWS’ product page can be found here: https://aws.amazon.com/products/?nc2=h_ql_p.

In addition, AWS offers a variety of support services to help customers in deploying AWS services, as well as a comprehensive training and certification program. Finally, AWS also offers a Marketplace, enabling customers to locate, buy and immediately use digital products sold by third-party sellers.

Amazon Shipping is building the future of parcel delivery for businesses across the EU. We pick up parcels directly from our shippers' facilities and deliver them to their end consumers using Amazon's world-class logistics network.
We're looking for a Shipper Experience Manager to own the operational relationship with a portfolio of shippers. You'll be the single point of contact from operations for your shippers within Amazon Shipping — their trusted advisor and their advocate internally. You'll onboard new shippers, drive performance across your portfolio, and ensure every shipper gets an exceptional level of service.
You'll drive alignment across partner teams, track actions to completion, and hold the network accountable for delivering results. You'll partner with Single Threaded Leaders, programme teams, and operational stakeholders to reduce costs, improve quality, and drive adoption of new capabilities with your shippers.
You'll need to be a supply chain subject matter expert who can translate complex operational realities into clear solutions for shippers. You'll visit shipper sites, host business reviews at all cadences, and use data and anecdotes to drive structural change internally. If you're energised by working at the intersection of customer experience and operational excellence, this is the role for you.
Our team is in a test-and-iterate phase — we're building new processes, refining our approach, and evolving quickly. You'll need to be highly flexible, comfortable with change, and able to adapt at pace as priorities shift and the function matures.


Key job responsibilities
Portfolio Management & Performance
• Own the operational relationship with a portfolio of shippers, acting as their single point of contact within Amazon Shipping
• Monitor shipper performance across quality metrics including On-Time Performance (OTP), non-conveyable rates, and damages
• Track and drive improvement in safety metrics including prohibited items compliance
• Identify trends, root causes, and opportunities using data — drive alignment with responsible teams and track corrective actions to completion
• Proactively identify risks to shipper performance before they materialise and drive mitigating actions
• Understand shipper volume forecasts and coordinate with the network on peak planning and capacity impact

• Partner with Single Threaded Leaders (e.g. First Mile Cost) to reduce costs and improve outcomes for your shippers
• Collaborate with programme teams to drive shipper adoption of new programmes and initiatives

Voice of Shipper
• Act as the voice of the shipper internally, ensuring your portfolio receives the right level of service
• Educate internal stakeholders on shipper needs and use real-world examples to drive structural change
• Visit shipper sites regularly to build relationships, understand their challenges, and identify opportunities
Business Reviews & Governance
• Host Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) to track performance and address operational issues
• Host Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) to review trends, initiative progress, and strategic alignment

Our Program Manager's are always thinking about the bigger picture. Every position at Amazon offers the opportunity for employees to influence business decisions and shape the future. But as a Senior Program Manager, pioneering new ways of thinking, designing and delivering is your mission. Collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders across the business, you’ll continuously be scoping out new solutions. You’ll conduct your own research and analysis, always with an eye on the long-term vision of the business. This is your opportunity to have a big impact on some of the most exciting new ideas that are shaping the future of Amazon.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract position.

Key job responsibilities
- Create innovative solutions using data and research to address wider challenges in your organization
- Take a big-picture approach in your analysis of business operations, driving improvements across a range of teams and organizations
- Work alongside senior leadership to establish and prioritize improvement programs, seeing them through from start to finish
- Enhance operational performance on every program in partnership with your stakeholders

A day in the life
As a Senior Program Manager, you’ll drive and manage the implementation of creative, data-driven change in Amazon, leading improvement projects and programs. You’ll use strategic thinking to define and implement an efficient project plan. Some managers are based on-site while others work remotely, depending on the most suitable option for their team and tasks.

Senior Program Managers have significant responsibilities, and you’ll deal with complex challenges with creativity, innovation, and leadership. With a responsibility extending beyond process improvements, you could also contribute to improving other areas of the business, like diversity, equity, and inclusion.

About the team
When you click on your screen, and know that your Amazon parcel will arrive with you on the next day, you’ve just use one of the world’s most sophisticated fulfillment networks. At AMZL Europe, we deliver millions of packages daily to customers at record speed and quality. The work that Launch and Expansion do is at the heart of that. Our relentless ambition is to make AMZL Europe more and more cost-effective and customer centric. We’re doing that by improving our existing network, inventing new and creative ways of making last-mile delivery more efficient, and optimizing the development of our Under the Roof and On Road Infrastructure. Within the team we have a variety of roles. Typical examples include program managers responsible for selecting and launching new sites, planners working out how we solve challenges such as low emission zones and EV charging, strategy teams looking at how we get the most out of our existing buildings, and analysts using data to deliver insights into how we work and how we should be working.

Help plan the future of the biggest last mile delivery network in Europe
Select, build and launch huge buildings and infrastructure with multi-million dollar budgets
Make decisions that shape Amazon’s fulfillment strategy across the globe
Work at the forefront of logistics innovation

Do you enjoy going deep with the latest technology and have business skills necessary to help position AWS as the best cloud provider for Startups? Do you love driving technical strategy, building repeatable technical assets and have a background in Startups? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Startup team as a Principal TechLead for Specialist Solution Architects!

This position is part of the WWSO Startup team in EMEA, where you will set the GenAI technical strategy and support collaboration and development of the Specialist Solution Architect team, helping Startups accelerate and go deep across AWS’ GenAI offerings (ranging from Accelerated Compute, GPUs, Managed Inference, and distributed training and inference platforms), as well as underlying Core and Data services.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and support a team of excellent Specialist Solutions Architects who work with Startups in the EMEA Region (UK, Ireland, Israel, Middle-east, France, Germany, Nordics and other European countries).
- Set the Technical GTM Strategy for the team driving deep technical Thought Leadership
- Interact at the CxO/VP level, as well as with developers and technical architects, to ease adoption, develop pipeline, secure lighthouse customers, drive top-line revenue, and explore strategic partnerships.
- Become a trusted advisor within customer accounts through Technical Thought Leadership.
- Develop and deploy programs that leverage AWS Field Solution Architect teams, as well as technology and consulting partner channels.
- Collaborate with AWS Product and Technical teams to create solutions that solve customer problems, including reference architectures, patterns, automation, and release plan.

A day in the life
- Develop the best technologists and storytellers.
- Set direction and inspire deep-technical thought leadership across the team, keeping up with the fast-changing GenAI landscape.
- Drive collaboration across a cross-domain team of different cloud technologies.
- Work with the most promising Startups.
- Guide the team to find ways to scale tech knowledge and assets via workshops, blogs, products, programs, and the AWS Field.
- Gather critical Startup feedback to inform our product roadmaps.

About the team
The WWSO (Worldwide Specialist Organization) helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies, sitting in the sweet-spot between product teams, account sales teams and customer success roles. We are technology specialists, who work backwards from our customers’ most complex, business-critical problems to dive-deep and guide customers through technical expertise, joint with building and executing go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include technical solutions architecture roles and technical business development roles.

The WWSO Startup team, is a segment of WWSO dedicated to going deep with startups in their domain or technology. We work with AWS Service Teams to ensure services and features continue to match the accelerating speed of startup development. We also support the wider Startup ecosystem, partnering with VC's to best support a startup's journey on AWS.

target_jobs.description:
This is an 18-month fixed-term contract.

We are looking for a Speed programs manager to own end-to-end capacity planning for High Volume Events (HVE) across the EU5 Same Day network. This role sits
within the Speed Programs team and is responsible for ensuring our stations are resourced, planned, and ready to deliver on our customer promise during the most
demanding periods of the year — Prime Day, Peak (Black Friday/Cyber Monday), and other high-volume events.

You will work backwards from demand forecasts to build station-level capacity plans, identify gaps before they become misses, and drive cross-functional alignment
with Last Mile, Middle Mile, Operations, and partner teams to close them. You will own the planning calendar, mechanisms, and governance that ensure the network
moves from "plan" to "ready" with full accountability at each milestone.

This role requires someone who is comfortable operating in ambiguity, can translate large data sets into clear capacity decisions, and can hold partner teams
accountable to shared commitments under time pressure. You will be the single-threaded owner for HVE capacity readiness across EU5 Same Day — when Peak arrives,
your plans are what the network executes against.

**Key responsibilities:**

- Own the EU5 Same Day HVE capacity planning process end-to-end: demand ingestion, gap identification, action tracking, and readiness sign-off
- Build and maintain station-level capacity models for all Peak events, working with forecasting, operations, and network teams
- Identify capacity gaps (mechanical, OTR, UTR) early and drive resolution through established levers (DILO changes, route additions, overlap jurisdiction, CPT
shifts)
- Create and run the governance mechanisms (WBRs, readiness reviews, escalation paths) that ensure the network hits readiness milestones on schedule
- Partner with Operations, Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Tech teams to align inputs and commitments
- Produce clear, data-driven recommendations for senior leadership when trade-offs are required
- Build post-event retrospectives that feed learnings back into the next planning cycle

The Amazon Payment Acceptance & Experience Team is responsible for how Amazon's customers pay on Amazon's sites and through Amazon's services around the globe. You will work with the most relevant players in the payments industry to deliver best-in-class customer payment experiences while driving change in the industry.
You will use your expertise to build and strengthen relationships with UK and Irish financial institutions, card networks, and alternative payment providers to deliver seamless paying experiences across both markets. You will leverage deep knowledge of the UK and Ireland payments landscape — including Open Banking, Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), and local scheme dynamics — to proactively identify opportunities that improve customer payment success and reduce friction.


Key job responsibilities
• Build and own a holistic plan to improve key output metrics (Payment Success Rate, Cost of Payments, Customer Engagement) across the UK and Ireland, accounting for market-specific dynamics such as high contactless penetration, Open Banking adoption, and scheme behaviour
• Analyse internal Amazon and external data to identify improvement opportunities in authorisation rates, decline recovery, and cost optimisation, with particular focus on UK issuer dynamics and the Irish landscape
• Develop and maintain strategic relationships with UK and Irish issuers, acquirers, and scheme partners to conduct joint deep dives, resolve performance gaps, and unlock new capabilities and participating in working groups to shape standards
• Drive adoption and optimisation of features and partner or scheme-level tools to improve performance of main metrics for UK/IE, working with issuers and authentication providers to maximise rates
• Proactively create a feedback loop to Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities — e.g., launches, UX, features
• Drive UAT and end-to-end testing with banks, networks, and providers for new capabilities, regulatory changes, or migrations
• Monitor and respond to customer, regulatory and industry changes that impact payment acceptance, ensuring Amazon's compliance
