target_jobs.description:
Senior Enterprise Sales Specialist, Cloud Infrastructure Retail

Do you obsess over customer outcomes?

We're looking for a Senior Enterprise Sales Specialist, Cloud Infrastructure who starts with the customer's business challenge, works backwards from their goals, and builds migration and modernisation solutions that deliver real, measurable value across the full AWS platform.

Join a team of driven sales specialists focused on helping UK and Ireland customers achieve transformational business outcomes through cloud migration and modernisation. You will earn trust by deeply understanding each customer's priorities, then build pipeline and close revenue by positioning migration not as a technology project but as the fastest path to the business results they care about.

The ideal candidate is a quota-carrying sales specialist who leads with customer empathy and backs it with technical credibility. You engage at CXO level to understand business pain, and propose solutions that genuinely solve problems. You see migration as the commercial catalyst for larger transformation programmes that culminate in AI adoption and intelligent automation, and you build pipeline by earning trust and demonstrating long-term value. You thrive in ambiguity, own outcomes end-to-end, and make decisions independently. You are a self-starter, ready to develop and execute account and territory plans that exceed targets. You bring strong knowledge of SaaS and on-premises infrastructure (Nutanix, VMware, Hyper-V), colocation and hosting environments, and cloud platforms (GCP, Azure), along with a working understanding of Microsoft licensing and enterprise agreements.

How you will spend your time

80% working directly with customers: understanding their business objectives, uncovering what success looks like for them, and designing the most effective path from migration through to full platform value on AWS.
20% creating campaigns and building thought leadership: developing strategic campaigns that generate net-new pipeline and establishing yourself as a trusted voice in your domain.
You will engage across the full transformation lifecycle:

Migrate: infrastructure landing and workload mobility
Modernise: application refactoring, containerisation, serverless adoption
Activate Data: analytics, lake formation, AI/ML readiness
Deploy Applications: GenAI, agentic workloads, intelligent automation
Your role is to find, build, and close opportunities across this lifecycle, always starting from the customer's desired outcomes and working backwards to the right solution.

Key job responsibilities
- Deeply understand customer business objectives, industry dynamics, and competitive pressures to identify where migration and modernisation can deliver the highest-impact outcomes.
- Generate and manage pipeline for AWS Migrations and Modernisations within defined verticals in the UK and Ireland, rooted in genuine customer need.
- Identify, qualify and close M&M deals from the largest, priority customers and targets in your verticals, positioning migration as the entry point to broader platform value that solves real business problems.
- Think Big: own the strategy to grow the migration and modernisation business in your territory. Design and execute campaigns, create new routes to market, and identify untapped customer segments or use cases that expand the addressable opportunity beyond today's pipeline.
- Drive thought leadership that tells the end-to-end transformation story: from migration through modernisation, data activation, and AI deployment. Create content, deliver keynotes, host executive roundtables, and build market awareness that positions AWS as the platform for customers building the company of the future.
- Develop and deliver executive-level narratives that start with the customer's challenges: cost pressure, speed to market, data-driven decision making, operational resilience, and map these to migration and modernisation outcomes.
- Build compelling commercial propositions that connect migration events with data modernisation, AI adoption, and agentic business transformation, always anchored to customer-defined success metrics.
- Position AI and GenAI as the outcome layer of migration: help customers see how moving to AWS unlocks access to services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and partner AI technologies (e.g. Anthropic Claude) to drive competitive advantage post-migration.
- Own revenue targets across the full transformation lifecycle. Drive upsell and expansion by delivering on earlier promises and demonstrating measurable customer value at each stage.
- Work cross-functionally with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Partner teams, Professional Services, and Product to inventory customers' existing software estates, build business cases for transformation, develop implementation plans, and close agreements.
- Build and execute co-sell motions with Global Systems Integrators (e.g. Accenture, Deloitte, TCS, Wipro) and strategic technology partners (e.g. Anthropic, Databricks) to bring joint migration-to-AI propositions to market and accelerate deal cycles.
- Leverage the AWS partner ecosystem to ensure customers get the right delivery support across large-scale migration and modernisation programmes.
- Respond to RFI/RFPs with differentiated, platform-level proposals that address what customers actually asked for, not generic capability decks.
- Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast; deliver predictable revenue against quota.
- Act as the voice of the customer internally: feed customer insights back to product, engineering, and partner teams to improve the AWS migration and modernisation experience.
- Travel to customer sites across the UK and Ireland as needed


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon’s Tax Services organization is building the next generation of solutions to shape the way that we calculate, collect and invoice tax information as one of the world’s largest collectors of online indirect taxes and fees. Our organization’s mission is to ensure that Amazon has the right technology and processes to remain accurate and adaptable in a rapidly changing business and tax environment.

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for a Sr Product Manager - Technical (Sr PM-T) to join us in London and help build the future of the Tax Services document printing product, which is responsible for generating billions of business-critical documents (e.g. tax invoices, commercial and transport documents) every year. As a Sr PM-T, you will be responsible for identifying and executing on opportunities to build high-impact solutions and features for our document printing product that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial product manager who is passionate about solving complex and ambiguous problems, and who thrives in a fast-paced environment. This position has a high level of visibility, so you will need to be able to communicate clearly and compellingly at all levels of the company. Additionally, you will be responsible for measuring business impact by diving deep into metrics, tying inputs to business outcomes, and working backwards from customers. You should have a positive attitude and strong work ethic; you will work fast and smart, and adapt and iterate quickly. This role operates in highly ambiguous areas – ideal candidates have a proven track record of bringing clarity, simplifying and prototyping to iterate fast.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

- Influence the development and execution of high-quality feature roadmaps based on the overall product strategy and vision.
- Understand and explain the impact of product features on the strategic value, useability and performance of the document printing product.
- Make prioritization and trade-off decisions among customer experience, scope, and time to market.
- Manage product planning and development through day-to-day collaboration and decision making with a cross-functional team including engineers, designers, and business development partner teams.
- Develop detailed, crisp user stories with acceptance criteria based on customer needs/experience and business requirements that can be used to create product specifications and architecture.
- Define and analyze metrics that measure and benchmark product success.

A day in the life
As a Sr PM-T in Tax Services, your day will be a mix of meetings and heads-down time for strategy and roadmap planning, and tactical execution. You’ll meet with customers and peers across product, engineering, UX, tax and legal to understand their needs and identify feature needs for our document printing product. You’ll develop functional product and user experience requirements for new features and processes to help meet our customer needs. You will be expected to own the end-to-end roadmap for discrete product features from requirements gathering through to implementation, working across teams to break down silos and drive feature delivery on the product. You will partner closely with the Tax Services engineering team to drive technology design outcomes that are scalable to support all of Amazon’s business and compliance needs. The work you deliver has a direct impact on the future portfolio of product for the Tax Services organization.

target_jobs.description:
Want to build something that actually moves the needle — at Amazon scale? The Last Mile DSP Payments team is looking for a Sr Program lead who doesn't just want a seat at the table, but wants to roll up their sleeves and rebuild the table itself.

We move more than €1B a year across 9 countries, 2,000+ legal entities, and 37,000+ service rate combinations — today, a lot of that runs on semi-automated workflows, Excel files, and cross-functional muscle memory. That's exactly the opportunity: if you're the kind of person who sees a messy, high-stakes process and immediately starts sketching the fix, this is your playground. You'll be hands-on from day one, with real ownership over how hundreds of Delivery Service Partners get paid across Europe.

This isn't a role for someone who wants a fully paved roadmap. It's for someone who wants to build the road.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Do
Own and drive payment process improvement initiatives across EU manual and semi-automated workstreams — fleet, fuel, incentives, and beyond
Strengthen and build new financial controls and audit trails — find the gaps before they become problems
Build Excel-based tools, models, and dashboards (pivot tables, Power Query, macros, VBA) that replace manual grind with scalable systems
Chase down payment discrepancies across EU countries — trace the data, find the root cause, fix it, and make sure it doesn't come back
Turn messy operational reality into clean, structured requirements that fuel automation with Last Mile Payments Tech
Help shape and execute the DSP payment automation roadmap, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Finance, Tax, Fleet, Pricing, and Tech

A day in the life
- You're an Excel power user — pivot tables, Power Query, and macro/VBA automation are second nature (we'll put this to the test)
- You bring order to chaos — structured thinking that turns ambiguity into a clear plan, fast
- You communicate with energy and clarity — across functions, across geographies, up to leadership and down to the front line
- You learn fast and don't wait to be told twice — complex payment logic, regulatory nuance, and cross-functional dependencies are puzzles you enjoy solving
- You're up for travel — getting in the room with EU regional ops teams, on-site, is part of how you get things done
- You thrive under pressure — peak periods with serious financial stakes don't rattle you, they energize you

**Bonus points for:** AI skills, SQL, BI tools (QuickSight, Tableau), experience with offshore teams, or a second European language

About the team
Our team is focused on delivering programs that improve the experience for our customers while driving operational excellence across the business. We value collaboration, clear thinking, and a willingness to roll up our sleeves to get things done. As we continue to grow, we are investing in new mechanisms and scalable solutions that will shape how we operate in the years ahead. You will join an inclusive group of program managers who support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and take pride in delivering results that matter.

Amazon Shipping is seeking a Senior Content Program Manager to own our end-to-end content strategy across client-facing and internal support channels. You will design a comprehensive content framework covering SOPs, help documentation, policy updates, and new product launches, ensuring every piece is accurate, accessible, and built for the audiences it serves. You will benchmark against industry leaders, establish measurable goals to track content quality and effectiveness, and hold cross-functional stakeholders across technology, legal, marketing, operations, and commercial teams accountable to their deliverables. A core part of this mandate is reducing support escalations by ensuring clear, actionable answers are available before a contact is ever created.

Content is the foundation of our AI strategy, and this role sits at the center of that vision. Every help article, SOP, and policy document developed here will feed directly into our AI tools, powering personalized, context-aware summaries and real-time guidance for associates managing complex support cases. You will define the taxonomy, structure, and quality standards that make content machine-readable and AI-ready, ensuring our models surface the right information at the right moment. Beyond written content, you will lead the development of interactive video experiences that translate complex operational topics into simple, intuitive formats that drive self-service adoption.

The ideal candidate brings a combination of analytical rigor and creative vision: someone who can build a content measurement framework from scratch, identify gaps through data, and translate ambiguous business needs into structured, scalable programs. You thrive in fast-moving environments, communicate with clarity across all levels of the organization, and understand that great content is not just well-written but strategically designed to move metrics. If you are energized by building something meaningful from the ground up and want your work to directly shape how thousands of shippers experience Amazon, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and own the end-to-end content strategy, building a scalable framework that covers SOPs, help documentation, policy changes, and new product launches for both external clients and internal support associates
- Benchmark content quality and effectiveness against industry leaders, define measurable goals, and establish review mechanisms to track performance and drive continuous improvement
- Lead cross-functional program management across technology, legal, marketing, operations, and commercial teams; define milestones, track progress, and hold stakeholders accountable to individual deliverables
- Define the taxonomy, structure, and quality standards that make content machine-readable and AI-ready, ensuring our tools surface accurate, personalized, and context-aware information at the right moment
- Lead the development of interactive video and multimedia experiences that translate complex operational topics into simple, intuitive formats, reducing cognitive load and driving self-service adoption
- Author and lead high-judgment business reviews and leadership documents, including MBRs, QBRs, and VP goal reviews, with clear commentary on program status, risks, and mitigations
- Develop and maintain playbooks and process documentation to standardize and scale content programs across the organization
- Navigate ambiguity with confidence, structuring complex problems into clear, actionable plans while managing multiple workstreams simultaneously

target_jobs.description:
In this role, you will be part of the team that ensures AWS's supply chain can deliver the datacenter racks, servers, and networking equipment to our datacenters across the globe. The rest of the supply chain looks to us to clear strategic problems and "enable" them to focus on execution. We are the jack-of-all-trades with the best understanding of how the entire end-to-end supply chain works and how to help it run better.

This is a senior-level Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) role, responsible for building and executing AWS's Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM) program and serves as the vital tactical link to our centralized corporate Trade, Tax, and Compliance organizations. This is a high-judgment role, where you will represent the AWS supply chain during engagements with public sector customers, and must be able to translate customer and regulatory requirements into actionable deliverables, determine what is a true requirement versus a nice-to-have, and understand how to find the balance between cybersecurity and business objectives.

The ideal candidate is a technically savvy individual leader, capable of leveraging AWS's internal business and artificial intelligence tool to gather data and identify risks before they become problems, as well as interact with both internal and external senior leaders to gain support for new initiatives and obtain consensus with AWS customers.

You will be responsible for identifying, creating, and delivering on your initiatives and must have both excellent interpersonal and writing skills to work across myriad teams in the supply chain, security, and legal organizations to deliver results in an ambiguous operating environment. It will be your responsibility to ensure the supply chain delivers on our security and risk management commitments to our customers, as well as make sure region build and operational teams are able to get the infrastructure hardware they need when they need it.

This position requires that the selected candidate already be a UK citizen and, after starting, obtain the commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Driving consensus and standardization for acceptable levels of risk and best practices across supply chain operations
- Developing technical solutions that drive automation at scale to ensure datacenter infrastructure is delivered on-time, in-full
- Proactively working with other organizations to anticipate gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, influencing where no formal reporting structures exist
- Articulating in writing (actual papers, not slides) key issues and strategic initiatives for senior leadership
- Acting as a thought and business leader in the field of cybersecurity, supply chain risk management, and supply chain operations

A day in the life
You are at the intersection of the Venn diagram for security, operations, and risk management, and thus work with a variety of different stakeholders. You will primarily focus on addressing supply chain security and risk concerns for UK-based public sector customers to allow the supply chain to operate smoothly, but the team supports our global footprint and you will collaborate with international peers to drive standardization and scalable practices across the global supply chain.

About the team
Our team has the greatest end-to-end view and understanding of AWS's supply chain and sits at the center of the Venn diagram of supply chain security, operations, and risk management. We build bridges with both internal and external customers across those different disciplines to find the right balance between them.

Amazon are seeking a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to support our European Data Center infrastructure growth initiatives. Based in London, the TIPM will lead cross functional teams to drive the implementation and deployment of data center expansion projects to meet the demands of our rapidly growing business.

Our Technical Program Managers are strong communicators both written and verbally and lead multi-discipline, highly technical physical infrastructure project teams. They lead teams of internal and external stakeholders through all stages of the Data Center development lifecycle from initial site due diligence through Construction and into Operation. The core role of the TIPM is to deliver capacity for our customers through developing delivery programs and working closely with stakeholder teams to identify risks and resolve issues to ensure those programs are delivered on time and within budget.

The TIPM partners with various stakeholder teams during data center delivery; Real Estate to support the feasibility and selection of new sites; Energy to ensure suitable grid connection is available; Design Engineering to coordinate project specific inputs, constraints and risks into designs; Procurement to secure on time delivery of critical equipment; Construction Management to track budget & progress; and Operations to complete the project with successful handover, to name but a few.

• Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional and remote teams.

• Build and maintaining overall delivery program and project budget, submitting Capital Allocation Requests to Senior leadership to secure finance for project delivery.
• Work with Capacity Planning, Energy and Real Estate teams to develop short & long term build strategies to meet forecast demand.

Our new experience brings together the best of Rufus and Alexa+ to deliver a more personal, helpful shopping experience across a wide range of surfaces and devices—from the Amazon Shopping app and website to Echo Show, where customers can now browse and shop the full Amazon store using voice, touch, or both.

You will work alongside design leadership to deliver a best-in-class conversational shopping experience to our hundreds of millions of customers. We have a bold vision to create the world’s best AI Shopping Assistant, and this role will be a critical partner in delivering on that.

- Own programme strategy for end-to-end delivery
- Act as a bridge between UX, Engineering, and Product, connecting all three groups and making sure interdependencies are understood and planned for

- Apply project management best practices to make the team you work with more efficient

- Identify roadblocks and drive the resolution of problems with appropriate autonomy

You empower the UX team to own their timelines and deliverables, and support them by clarifying requirements, clearing blockers, and mitigating risk to ensure milestones are met. You are an effective, concise, and clear communicator, with a proven track record of effective meeting management. You drive improvements to communication mechanisms, tools, and standards to facilitate optimal output. You are an equal owner, and often represent the design team’s strategy and POV in key forums such as partner team meetings, office hours or leadership reviews.

Advertising is one of the fastest growing areas at Amazon. Our Ad Tech suite of products — including Amazon DSP (ADSP), Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) and Amazon Ads APIs — allow our customers to leverage Amazon's unique media, audience, and e-commerce assets to drive meaningful results for their business.

Ad Tech Solutions (ATS) is the technical solutions arm of our ad tech services organization. ATS’ charter is to help our largest customers achieve their business outcomes with Amazon's Ad Tech, building on our APIs and AWS services.

ATS is seeking an Senior Ad Tech Consultant to join our European practice with a focus in the UK while also supporting other EU5 countries including Germany, France, Spain and Italy. You will help customers to achieve their business outcomes by solving technical challenges related to conversion tracking, first party data uploads, API development, AMC SQL query customization, and building custom audiences. You will work closely with our Ad Tech Account Executives to accelerate customer adoption of DSP and AMC to increase their advertising ROI and drive more investment. You will help Data Analysts, Data Scientists, IT Analysts, and Developers in our customer's organizations solve complex technical challenges so that their agency or brand can make strategic advertising and data decisions. You will be able to assess and adapt our customers’ SQL skills to maximize their time and value in using our products. You’ll drive technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams. You’ll lead customer-tailored engagements, demonstrating the integrated value of AMC and DSP in combination with their AWS technology investments.

You’ll also act as a technical thought leader in the ad tech community. This includes playing a lead role in educating, sharing best practices, writing white papers, and running "Working Backwards" sessions with customers. As a customer-obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our ad tech products and services by gathering feedback from customers and collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

Key job responsibilities
• In partnership with the ad tech sales team, educate customers on the value proposition of Amazon’s Ad Tech Suite and participate in deep technical discussions and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on Amazon’s Ad Tech and AWS platforms.

• Lead data and analytics discussions and design customer workshops to become an expert on our customer’s technical needs and business goals.

• Drive usage and adoption. Your customer engagements will result in our customers generating valuable insights that they can use to make smarter investments on and off Amazon media properties. You will continuously monitor the inputs you drive to measure the output of activation.

• Be a customer advocate. You will take your learnings from customer engagements and work with Advertising engineering teams as input into integration and ad tech roadmaps.

• Contribute to the creation and delivery of best practices, packaged offerings, certification paths, white papers, and workshops.

• This is a customer facing role within the EU region focused on the UK. You will be required to travel to client locations to deliver when needed.

You’ll collaborate with a broad group of people across AWS and act as the conduit between our customers and AWS product teams. Most importantly, you’ll make a difference by applying your expertise to our customers’ most critical problems.

target_jobs.description:
About Amazon Ads

Amazon Ads is the digital advertising arm of Amazon and one of our fastest growing businesses. We operate at the intersection of commerce, entertainment and advertising. Amazon Ads offers unique advertising products, enterprise ad tech and a rich array of unique creative, format and measurement solutions. We believe that advertising, when done well, can connect the right brands with the right consumers while delivering holistic value.

Twitch is the world's leading live-streaming platform, home to a highly engaged, hard-to-reach audience that spends billions of minutes each month watching gaming, entertainment, sports, music and creator-led content. As Twitch continues to scale its advertising proposition across EMEA, the ability to articulate the unique value of Twitch audiences to advertisers is a critical growth lever - and a capability we are building from the ground up.

This is an individual contributor role embedded within the Twitch Go-to-Market (GTM) team who will focus on Insights and Measurement. You will work extensively with the Twitch sales specialists, GTM leads, product and ad-tech teams to develop and deliver insights that directly fuel revenue growth.

This is not a backend role. You will actively participate in customer meetings as the subject matter expert on Twitch audience insights & measurement, and leverage Amazon's rich array of insights and measurement solutions - combined with Twitch-native data - to deliver media strategies that position Twitch as an essential part of the advertising mix.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the Twitch insights playbook from scratch: Develop a scalable library of Twitch audience insights, competitive benchmarks and measurement case studies that the sales team can deploy across pitches, QBRs and strategic conversations.

- Equip the sales team to sell with confidence: Translate complex Twitch audience data (viewership, engagement, demographics, content affinities) into clear, compelling narratives that articulate the unique and incremental value of Twitch to advertisers.

- Establish and advance senior-level relationships: Build relationships with senior marketing decision makers (e.g. Senior Director, C-level) by positioning yourself as the go-to expert on Twitch audience intelligence and at least one advanced analytical area of advertising.

- Generate data-driven insights: Leverage Amazon's proprietary data, Twitch-native signals, third-party research and ad measurement solutions to generate actionable insights that prove the impact of advertising on Twitch.

- Develop Twitch measurement expertise: Develop expertise in Twitch-specific metrics and Amazon's proprietary measurement tools, working to constantly evolve how we analyse and communicate the value of Twitch audiences to advertisers.

- Directly support revenue growth: Partner with GTM and sales leadership to identify the highest-impact insight gaps, prioritise your roadmap accordingly, and measure your work against pipeline and revenue outcomes.

- Advocate for data-driven decision-making: Guide advertisers to implement recommended solutions, with a particular focus on demonstrating Twitch's role in full-funnel and cross-platform strategies.

- Influence product and go-to-market strategy: Write internal documents with strategic recommendations that influence the direction of Twitch advertising products, measurement capabilities and go-to-market working mechanisms with internal stakeholders.

- Scale your analyses: Actively scale your analyses to other categories or locales through AI-native solutions.



A day in the life
No two days at Amazon are the same. You will have the flexibility to work with your stakeholders and define a book of business that will maximise your impact on Twitch revenue. On any given day, you might find yourself:
- Building a bespoke audience profile to help a seller win a competitive brief in colaboration with our Audience&Insights organization
- Presenting Twitch viewership insights at a sales-led event or advertiser summit
- Partnering with the GTM team to shape the narrative for a tentpole moment like TwitchCon
- Running an intricate analysis to influence a key advertiser decision
- Working with the product/engineering team to pilot a new measurement solution tailored to live-streaming environments
- Collaborating with the A&I team to bring methodological rigour to a Twitch-specific research project

About the team
Twitch GTM team - a small, high-impact squad responsible for equipping Twitch-dedicated sellers across EU5 with the strategies, tools and narratives they need to hit ambitious growth targets. You will also work closely with the Analytics & Insights (A&I) team within Amazon Ads, a sales enablement group responsible for developing actionable and innovative insights that prove the value of Amazon Ads to advertisers and partners.

Your unique position bridging both teams means you will bring the rigour and methodology of A&I together with the commercial urgency and customer proximity of GTM - a combination that is essential to closing the insights gap and unlocking Twitch's revenue potential.

Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon websites and wondered how it got delivered to you so fast, and what kinds of systems & processes are running behind the scenes to power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.




Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for driving all aspects of the First Mile analytics roadmap — the leg that moves inventory from our fulfillment and sort centers into the transportation network. This spans first-mile topology and connectivity, inbound-to-outbound flow design, FC-to-middle-mile injection, truck building and linehaul optimization out of our sites. The objective is to design the First Mile setup that lets us offer faster speed (including Same Day on a subset of the selection) at cost-parity with the rest of Store on a 3Y horizon. This is a role for an exceptionally talented person, with high energy and courage, passionate about delivering concrete improvement for our customers, and who wants to achieve that using data.

The role includes 40% of stakeholder/project management and 60% analytical activities.

Innovation & Stakeholder/Project management

Leverage planning and analytics tools developed by Science teams to assess the optimal First Mile topology, connectivity and flows
Use and share your insights with partner teams to influence strategic decisions (e.g. site connectivity, injection points, first-mile transportation design)
For the most complex and ambitious opportunities, quickly launch new pilots, and build scale-up business cases with benefits, bottlenecks, risks and resources required
For the algorithmic opportunities, work with teams of software developers and research scientists to design the next round of software innovation
Lead regular business reviews with partner teams to monitor the progress of projects in the roadmap. Help remove bottlenecks
Consolidate progress into crisp and concise data-driven status updates. You will own reporting to Amazon senior leadership (VP-level).
Data Analytics/Science

Deep dive complex data to uncover actionable insights for known and unknown problems
Good expertise with financial modelling (P&L, cashflow, mix/rate)
Candidates must be able to think and operate at all levels (both strategically and tactically).

Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion. Fulfillment acceleration is one of those Global transportation analytical team. We are obsessed by rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our customers can be delivered the next-day.

target_jobs.description:
Are you passionate about managing the technical partnerships that connect automotive retailers to new ways of selling vehicles online?

Amazon is revolutionizing the vehicle discovery and shopping experience, connecting customers with their ideal vehicle. As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will own the relationship with the dealer systems and third-party integrators that dealers depend on. Sitting at the intersection of Business Development, Engineering, and our integrator community, you are the trusted technical advisor and two-way translator — shaping the right integration paths for new partners, keeping integrators ahead of API changes, and driving our documentation toward true self-service.

This role requires deep understanding of automotive dealer systems and independent judgment about what is operationally critical for a dealer. You must be technically fluent (able to read API specs, reason about data flows, and troubleshoot integrations), excel at navigating ambiguity, and thrive in an entrepreneurial, with excellent interpersonal skills.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the technical foundation of Amazon’s automotive business. Your insights from working directly with the integrator community will directly influence our APIs, documentation, and marketplace within the Automotive sector.

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner with the BD team to assess prospective dealer and platform partners’ systems architecture and define the right integration path with Amazon's automotive business, bringing solutioning expertise into partner conversations.
2. Map dealer/DMS/platform capabilities to our APIs, surface constraints and dependencies early, and apply independent judgment on what is critical for dealer operations (inventory accuracy, transaction flows, data fidelity) to steer integration design.
3. Work closely with Engineering to understand upcoming API updates, deprecations, and new capabilities before they ship.
4. Proactively communicate API changes to the integrator community with enough lead time and clarity for them to plan and execute their own updates.
5. Act as the first line of technical support for integrators — answering questions, troubleshooting integration issues, and escalating to Engineering when needed.
6. Drive the accuracy and currency of API documentation by coordinating with the internal owners of each API surface.
7. Feed real integrator questions and friction points back into the documentation to continuously push it toward true self-service and reduce question volume at the source.
8. Build and manage durable relationships across BD, Engineering, documentation owners, and the external integrator ecosystem, operating with influence.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Partner Integration Manager, you will work cross-functionally with Business Development, Engineering, and Product Management, while building and maintaining relationships with technical stakeholders across our external integrator and dealer-platform community. One part of your day may be spent advising BD on a prospective partner’s integration path; another translating an upcoming API change into clear guidance for integrators; another troubleshooting a live integration issue and feeding what you learn back into the documentation. You will be instrumental in defining how integrators build on Amazon's automotive business, providing valuable technical insights to product and engineering teams, and creating initiatives that scale integrator self-service.

This role is based in London with occasional travel to meet with dealer platform partners and integrators.

About the team
This role explores opportunities to innovate in the automotive space. Our team aims to raise the bar on the car buying experience for end customers, while enabling industry partners and integrators to build and grow efficiently by leveraging Amazon’s capabilities.

target_jobs.description:
At eero, we pride ourselves on dedication to customers, and our enterprise partners are no exception. Partner Success Management is responsible for ensuring partners can onboard efficiently, escalate concerns easily, and ultimately deploy eero successfully to their customers. In this role, you'll set the standard for how we work with external partners, interpret their needs, and prioritise eero workflows dedicated to partner success.

You'll support the complete partner lifecycle—from initial onboarding through ongoing optimisation. Along the way, you'll review partner requests, ensure eero teams are aligned on requirements, and coordinate cross-functional efforts to meet external commitments. Once new partners have completed their initial deployment, you'll continue partnering with them by offering support and insights to ensure they're making the most of their eero experience.

Key job responsibilities
You'll drive partner success by managing all facets of the partner lifecycle for large, complex strategic accounts. This includes defining and coordinating partners' programme requirements, managing non-standard partner needs, and accelerating deployments by identifying programme expansion opportunities. You'll acquire deep knowledge of customers' vision, products, and objectives, anticipating partner needs and resolving significant pain points before they escalate. As their advocate, you'll work with internal teams and provide compelling evidence to inspire action whilst assisting with sales product demonstrations and coordinating product training for new partners.

You'll steer eero to focus its partner-related efforts on work that delivers the biggest positive impact. This means balancing customer needs with competing business priorities, identifying efficiency opportunities, automating repetitive work, and designing scalable workflows. As a strategic adviser, you'll earn partners' trust and influence their customer-facing technology strategy, helping them optimise their eero programmes to deliver exceptional customer experiences whilst maximising partner value.

You'll create and utilise reporting, analytics, data modelling, and business case analysis to identify opportunities for partners and ensure their objectives are achieved through quantitative insights.

A day in the life
As a Partner Success Manager in the Operations team within eero, your day will involve collaborating with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Manufacturing Operations teams to advance partner initiatives. You'll spend time analysing partner performance data, preparing strategic recommendations, and facilitating cross-functional meetings to resolve partner escalations. You'll balance proactive outreach—checking in with partners on deployment progress and identifying expansion opportunities—with reactive problem-solving as urgent issues arise. Throughout the day, you'll translate technical requirements into actionable plans, update stakeholders on programme status, and ensure partners have the resources and support needed to succeed with eero.

About the team
Partner Success Management sits within the Operations team at eero, where we're dedicated to ensuring our enterprise partners achieve exceptional outcomes. Our team serves as the strategic bridge between eero and our partners, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Manufacturing Operations to deliver seamless partner experiences. We pride ourselves on being partner advocates internally whilst maintaining a pragmatic, data-driven approach to prioritisation. Our culture values proactive problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement. If you're passionate about building lasting partnerships and driving measurable impact, you'll thrive here.

Amazon Creative Studios is an in-house creative studio partnering with brands to produce high-quality creative work. The Sr. Producer, Creative Partnerships is a key relationship and delivery role, responsible for building and growing the brand partnerships that the studio serves.

target_jobs.description:
Reinvent how the world's largest robotics network gets deployed.
Amazon is seeking a Senior Manager for our Robotics Delivery, Packaging & Innovation to define and lead the Design for Deployment (DfD) technical deep-dive, and associated implementation strategy, across our global robotics fulfillment network. This is a founding, build-it-from-scratch role: you will define what "deployable" means for every robotics technology Amazon ships, and your decisions will shape how thousands of implementations happen across six continents.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Vercelli or alternatively in London or Luxembourg with ~60% travel across Europe and internationally for design reviews and field validation activities.

Key job responsibilities
This is a hands-on, boots-on-the-ground technical role. In the role you will:

- Serve as the organization's DfD technical authority, overview engineering drawings, mechatronic designs, and controls architectures, to embed quantified deployment requirements into engineering design, providing a single consolidated deployment voice and force multiplying deployment teams across multiple technology programs.
- Drive technically complex DfD programs: determining feasibility of infrastructure builds at scale, identifying when deployment issues stem from technical design decisions, and driving engineering to design to a defined deployment bar (mechanical, electrical, controls, layout, system integration and mechatronic domains).
- Advise VPs and the broader Robotics leadership on strategy, governance mechanisms and trade-offs, drive clarity where the problem itself may be undefined, optimize cross-organizational structures that enable teams to deliver independently.
- Coach deployment teams to engage in engineering design reviews, design decisions, and feed field learnings back to product teams systematically. You'll mentor deployment engineers and TiPMs, sharing DfD best practices and technical deep-dive methods and helping managers guide career growth.
- Define and own the end-to-end DfD strategy across all technology programs, ensuring every program has a quantified deployment bar (installation duration, workforce management, safety risk, cost per unit install).
- Force multiply deployment teams by creating, optimizing, and driving adoption of DfD mechanisms that enable teams to operate independently and at scale.
- Decompose complex deployment design problems into straightforward infrastructure solutions; define DfD Core Tenets and quantified requirements that engineering designs to across all solutions.
- Establish and evangelize the principle that deployment data is influence currency: creating systems and expectations for teams to document and quantify deployment pain caused by design decisions, replacing anecdotal feedback with systematic, data-driven design influence.
- Remediate critical and/or endemic deployment design problems; make trade-offs between business opportunity, resources, and sustainability with a long-term perspective.
- Identify endemic deployment problems, such as recurring modularity constraints, cable management challenges, or commissioning inefficiencies, diagnosing them and drive engineering to eliminate them at the source rather than compensating in the field.
- Drive measurable DfD outcomes and metrics, such as reduction in deployment duration, cost per unit, first-time installation success rate.

A day in the life
As a Sr. Manager, you will be the person that engineers and design owners come to for the deployment verdict. Your work will have global impact across multiple organizational goals and program-related metrics.

- You'll operate with complete independence in an area where business and infrastructure build strategy may not yet be defined.
- You will spend real time on the floor, next to the machines and the teams installing them, which is exactly where this role earns its credibility and its impact.
- You'll partner with other Robotics teams to validate design improvements and quantify realized savings against targets.
- You'll drive the cultural shift across the organization: coaching teams to stop absorbing complexity and start preventing it, building confidence in deployment engineers to challenge design decisions with data, and establishing new norms where field intelligence flows systematically back to product teams.

No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for strategic impact as part of a collaborative, high-performing team.

About the team
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon’s leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfillment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the long-term security architect for a defined set of enterprise customers within one to two industry verticals guiding their adoption of AWS security services from initial discovery through launch readiness
- Operate as one half of a dedicated two-person team with a Security Specialist Seller - you own solution architecture, technical validation, and customer confidence; your seller owns opportunity origination and deal strategy

Your morning might start with a Financial Services customer whose CISO needs to consolidate five security vendors into a unified posture management framework - you map their current detection stack against AWS-native capabilities and sketch a phased migration plan. Amazon Shipping is building the future of parcel delivery for businesses across the EU. We pick up parcels directly from our shippers' facilities and deliver them to their end consumers using Amazon's world-class logistics network.
We're looking for a Sr. Shipper Experience Manager to own the operational relationship with our most complex and strategically important shippers. These are high-volume, multi-faceted accounts with complex supply chains that require a senior operator who can navigate ambiguity, shape strategy, and drive outcomes across organisational boundaries.
You'll be the single point of contact from operations for your shippers — but at this level, you're also expected to define the playbook. You won't just follow established processes; you'll identify gaps, design new approaches, and raise the bar for how we manage shipper relationships across the function. You'll influence senior stakeholders, shape OP1 narratives, and mentor junior team members.
You'll drive alignment across partner teams, track actions to completion, and hold the network accountable for delivering results. The difference at this level is the complexity of the problems you'll solve, the seniority of the stakeholders you'll influence, and your ability to independently define the right approach when there isn't a clear precedent.
You'll need deep supply chain expertise and the judgement to translate that into strategy for your shippers. You'll host business reviews, visit shipper sites, and use data and anecdotes to drive structural change internally. If you thrive in ambiguity and are energised by complex, high-impact customer problems, this is the role for you.
Our team is in a test-and-iterate phase — we're building new processes, refining our approach, and evolving quickly. You'll need to be highly flexible, comfortable with change, and able to adapt at pace. As a Sr. Shipper Experience Manager, we'll look to you to help shape that change and bring the team along with you.


Key job responsibilities
Portfolio Management & Performance
• Own the operational relationship with a portfolio of Amazon Shipping's most complex and high-volume shippers
• Independently develop account strategies for your portfolio, defining the approach for shippers where no established playbook exists
• Monitor and drive shipper performance across quality metrics including OTP, non-conveyable rates, and damages
• Track and drive improvement in safety metrics including prohibited items compliance
• Identify systemic trends and root causes across your portfolio — drive alignment with responsible teams, track corrective actions to completion, and escalate where progress stalls
Shipper Onboarding
• Lead the operational onboarding of complex new shippers, including those with non-standard requirements or multi-site operations
• Define and refine onboarding approaches for shipper profiles that fall outside standard processes
• Set shippers up for success with clear expectations, SLAs, and tailored operational support
Cross-Functional Leadership
• Partner with Single Threaded Leaders (e.g. First Mile Cost, Network Planning) to reduce costs and improve outcomes — influencing at a senior level to prioritise your shippers' needs
• Collaborate with programme teams to drive shipper adoption of new programmes, providing strategic input on rollout sequencing and shipper readiness
• Own planning mechanism intakes for your domain, authoring narratives, aligning with commercial peers, and presenting data to senior leadership
• Identify process gaps and propose mechanisms to improve how the Shipper Excellence function operates at scale
• Assess whether solutions need to be applied locally or globally — identifying when a shipper problem is systemic and requires a worldwide fix
Voice of Shipper
• Act as the voice of the shipper at a senior level, influencing cross-functional priorities and resource allocation
• Educate senior internal stakeholders on shipper needs, using real-world examples to drive structural and systemic change
• Visit shipper sites regularly to build executive-level relationships, understand their strategic challenges, and identify opportunities

We're looking for someone with that senior-level experience to lead the EU relationship with one of our biggest and most complex Fashion & Sports vendors in the Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) program. You'll own the end-to-end account strategy across multiple European marketplaces, act as a consultant to senior vendor stakeholders, and drive measurable long-term growth. This is a dedicated, single-vendor role — not a portfolio.

You'll operate at the intersection of e-commerce strategy, cross-functional leadership, and vendor consulting. That means designing and executing multi-marketplace growth plans, coordinating teams across Advertising, Supply Chain, and Category, and partnering directly with the vendor's Sales and Account Directors. Your Fashion or Sports industry knowledge will be essential as you define success metrics, clear blockers for the account team, and surface new business opportunities that shape the future of our service. Along the way, you'll build EU-wide strategic leadership experience, develop executive-level vendor relationships, and take on org-wide projects that stretch beyond your immediate account.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end EU account strategy for a top-tier Fashion & Sports vendor, applying your senior account management and industry expertise to design and execute growth plans across multiple marketplaces and categories.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams (Account Managers, Advertising, Supply Chain, Item Data Quality), setting priorities, defining metric goals, and clearing blockers so the account team can execute effectively.
- Lead cross-divisional projects spanning Marketing & Promotions, Selection, and Operational Excellence at vendor level, as well as strategic EU-wide initiatives for the Amazon Vendor Services or Retail organization.
- Build long-term consulting relationships with senior vendor stakeholders (Sales Directors, Account Directors), leveraging your Fashion or Sports background to identify new business opportunities rooted in vendor and customer needs.
- Provide strategic direction for EU workstreams on key vendor priorities, ensuring the right resources and focus are in place to deliver results through the broader team.

A day in the life
Your week balances deep strategic work with high-touch collaboration. You might start the day reviewing performance data across marketplaces to spot trends, then join a call with the vendor's Commercial Director to align on a joint growth initiative. Mid-week, you're leading a cross-functional sync with Advertising, Supply Chain, and local account managers to unblock a promotional plan. Later in the week, you're building the quarterly business review narrative or scoping a new project that could scale across the org.

About the team
We're the EU Fashion & Sports Amazon Vendor Services team — a group of senior account managers who operate as strategic consultants to some of the biggest fashion and sports brands on Amazon. Unlike traditional vendor management, this is a paid service: our vendors choose to work with us, which means the bar for quality, trust, and commercial impact is high.

We're investing in how GenAI can transform our work, from automating operational tasks to finding new ways to accelerate vendor growth. If you want to combine strategic account leadership with AI-augmented ways of working, this team is building that future now. We value commercial sharpness and the ability to simplify complexity. If you enjoy operating where strategy meets execution, with real accountability for outcomes, this is the right environment.

Amazon’s Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a ST Forecasting Manager, you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders to Retail teams and everything in between. You’ll help us optimize our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Scope and Influence: A ST Forecasting Manager in Forecasting supports key forecasting programs across teams within and also across his/her organizations. She/He is responsible to define the roadmaps, aligning priorities and the goals, defining the milestones and the cross-functional framework to deliver forecasting roadmaps enhancing forecasting processes and metrics. With his/her support drives or enables key business critical decisions also when they are speed critical. This role mentors junior team members and coaches them on forecasting processes and improvement initiatives.

Execution of Forecasting Processes and Projects: manages difficult forecasting processes and enables the success of larger, more-complex and diverse projects serving the forecasting and planning teams. This role is heavily involved in scoping the program requirements and drives team(s)/partners to meet goals, from inception to their maintenance in the everyday use. Their work typically affects one region across also multiple teams' goals and forecasting metrics.

Degree of Ambiguity: the complexity lies with the complicated middle mile network structure. As a result, business problem and program strategy are often undefined. Despite that, this role delivers results independently, even though seeks for directions from peers, stakeholders and line managers.

Process Improvement: A ST Forecasting Manager uses his/her expertise in the tactical space to identify structural improvement opportunities in the forecasting space, and then works cross-orgs to implement them.

Key job responsibilities
Define supply chain and operating models for various businesses
-Analyze and interpret data to improve efficiency across supply chains and multiple operations
-Partner with teams to advise on and manage operational challenges
-Support the planning and organization of complex projects

A day in the life
Being a ST Forecasting Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.

As a ST Forecasting Manager, you’ll need to help with both on-the-ground tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site’s resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

About the team
Amazon couldn’t deliver at pace without the EU STEP Forecasting team. As part of EU STEP Forecasting team, you’ll be welcomed into a diverse team that plays a central role in our success. Using air, sea and road transport, as well as sortation centres equipped with the latest technology, you’ll help Amazon’s transport run at maximum efficiency. Our team captures data and uses it to drive decisions. They are key to making Amazon more innovative and efficient.
We put safety first as our people are our priority. And we use the expertise of our people to get packages to their destination – quickly, conveniently and sustainably.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

SCE is a specialized global deal team that engages with commercial and public sector customers on deal strategy, structuring, and negotiations through contractual closure for transformational, strategic, large, complex, and/or highly competitive opportunities such as GenAI. This is a unique opportunity to engage with AWS customers on strategic opportunities, increase the growth of AWS (EMEA), and to establish AWS as their key cloud technology provider. These opportunities range across industry verticals, such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Media & Entertainment, Energy, Healthcare Life Sciences, Automotive and Manufacturing, and Public Sector, and customer size (from start-ups to enterprise customers). These engagements may also involve Pan-Amazon and AWS go-to-market opportunities involving close partnership between the SCE team and other Amazon and AWS stakeholders.

As a SCE Deal Lead, you will be responsible for managing the end to end Deal Cycle for strategic, large, complex or highly competitive deals. You will focus on earning trust with customers by creating actionable strategies, developing and shaping opportunities, and leading deal engagements through negotiations and closure. This highly visible role will own engagement with customer C-level executives, IT teams, and multiple lines of business to achieve business outcomes, increase the adoption of AWS services, and to enable private pricing, go-to-market, pan-Amazon, and other strategic relationships. You will work collaboratively to drive results by partnering with AWS customers, AWS field sales executives, and other internal stakeholders to empower our customers to evolve, address challenges, and to create innovative solutions.

Key job responsibilities
Lead negotiations and customer closure for strategic, large, complex or highly competitive deals
Develop and shape the overall deal strategy and structure to meet customer business outcome and goals
Contribute to developing AWS's value proposition and solutions
Drive revenue growth and Cloud adoption
Closely collaborate with key stakeholders across the organization for (EMEA) regional sales teams, and related regional and global stakeholders (Service Teams, Finance, Legal, etc.)
Act as a trusted advisor in the development of the commercial strategy of deals with AWS Field Sales Executives: partner in the execution of the sales cycle for strategic, complex, or highly competitive commercial opportunities
Inspire, influence, and facilitate alignment with internal stakeholders, experts, and other resources not under direct control, to remove obstacles and achieve desired business outcomes
Develop strategies for pricing and discounts; effectively communicate and identify deal blockers
Lead or support presentation of deal proposals to Customers

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth’s most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.
Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, a S&OP Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network.
You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.


Key job responsibilities
- Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements
- Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels
- Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain
- Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience
- Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity


About the team
Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we’re always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile’ because it’s where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) is looking for a Program Manager to join the Operations Excellence Experts team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for supply chain optimization and process improvement, good project management skills, experience interfacing with external companies (e.g. Vendors, Sellers, B2B customers), relationship building skills and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders.

As an Operations Excellence Expert PM you will manage a small portfolio of Retail Vendors which rotate frequently (avg. 3-6 months engagement). You will evaluate the efficiency of the vendor's supply chain processes via data analysis and in person audit of the vendor's warehouses, identify root causes and improvement opportunities, prescribe improvement strategies, guide the improvement effort, and measure outcomes. In addition, you will work closely with internal stakeholders (e.g. Vendor Management, Supply Chain, Finance) to continuously improve the service and drive scalable processes/system improvements to eliminate defects.


Key job responsibilities

- Analyze operational defects and identify root causes for financial deductions, define joint action plan with the vendor and enable implementation.
- Facilitate regular progress reviews with vendors to create sustainable long-term results.
- Cooperate and build trusting relationship across job functions and levels within the vendor's organization (e.g. Key Account Mgr, Supply Chain Mgr, Finance Mgr, CEO, Customer Service Mgr).
- Organize and run two-day Kaizen workshops with internal and external attendees including visits to the vendor's warehouse(s) and Amazon FCs. Lead group discussions, process mapping, value stream mapping and brain storming sessions.
- Work on cross-functional projects with internal stakeholders related to the improvement and growth of the service (e.g. expanding the value proposition, facilitating pitching and vendor outreach, increasing team productivity).
- Frequent traveling within EU is required for this role

About the team
Amazon Vendor Services team (AVS) develops programs to disproportionately grow vendors on Amazon and seeks to continuously enhance its value proposition to vendors. One of the new programs is the AVS Operations Excellence Expert Service, which is a specialized offering for Amazon Retail vendors who are facing supply chain defects leading to financial deductions. It provides a dedicated consultative service aimed to identify and sustainably resolve root causes of financial deductions.

target_jobs.description:
Amazon’s Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international grocery and highly perishable supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will work closely with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams who are fulfilling customer orders, to Retail teams and everything in between. You’ll help us optimize our supply chains to make our customer experience even better and our business more energy and cost efficient.

Key job responsibilities
- Define our Demand Planning strategy in 5 European countries (UK, IT, ES, DE, FR), across our Fresh Online and Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) Grocery banners.
- Analyse and interpret data to deeply understand regional customer demand patterns and improve demand planning accuracy, helping the business drive efficiency across our end-to-end supply chain (from Inbound to Customer Outbound).
- Partner with ground Operations, Last Mile Delivery and Business teams, incorporating their inputs into our forecasting routine.
- Align complex Demand Planning strategies with Snr Leadership and financial partners.

A day in the life
Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to shape demand planning strategies for our ever growing groceries business.

As a Supply Chain Manager leading our S&OP vertical, you’ll need to help with both tactical and strategic work. No two days will be the same. You might spend Monday modelling demand scenarios for a new Amazon Fresh dark store launch, and Tuesday partnering with Last Mile Ops to resolve a resource capacity gap impacting our customer delivery speeds, across three International regions. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

This role will be carried out from our corporate location in London (LHR16 UK).

About the team
The INT Supply Chain Grocery Execution team breathes life into our newest ideas and incubates them until they grow into sophisticated businesses. We’ve got the energy of an exciting start-up, as our team works on Amazon’s next big project, under the umbrella of one of the world’s biggest companies.

We work behind the scenes to support new areas of the business - like Amazon Now (Quick Commerce) stores and our online grocery service. There are lots of opportunities for every skill set, from operations to supply chain to data management.

SC Execution's goal is to help develop new capabilities within Amazon on behalf of our customers. This entrepreneurial team has a deep understanding of the needs of our customers, employees and partners and helps to develop Amazon businesses of all sizes.

We grow new opportunities that will help Amazon diversify even more, taking them from concepts to mature operations that operate as standalone businesses. This dynamic environment supports our people’s growth and development.

Amazon's Supply Chain Managers play a central role in our global business. They keep our complex, international supply chains working seamlessly and efficiently. As a Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will collaborate with multiple stakeholders across Amazon, from Operational teams fulfilling customer orders to Retail teams and everything in between. You'll help us optimize our supply chains to enhance the customer experience while driving greater energy and cost efficiency across our business.

Key job responsibilities
- Inbound Service Level Management & Stock Availability: Own and drive inbound service level performance, ensuring timely receipt of inventory to maximise product availability and maintain optimal stock levels for customers.

- Inventory Space Planning & Capacity Optimisation: Manage inventory placement and space allocation across fulfilment sites, ensuring efficient utilisation of available storage capacity and forward planning for incoming stock.

- Inbound Scheduling & Short-Term Planning: Lead inbound scheduling activities and execute weekly planning adjustments to respond to demand fluctuations, operational constraints, and shifting priorities.

- Pallet Optimisation & Vendor Compliance: Drive single-product pallet compliance and adoption, working with suppliers and internal teams to increase pallet-level efficiency and reduce downstream handling costs.

- Inbound Flow Predictability & Volume Smoothing: Improve inbound flow predictability through level loading initiatives, supplier schedule management, and delivery trial programmes to smooth volume distribution and reduce peak-driven inefficiencies.

- Data Analysis & Supply Chain Modelling: Analyse and interpret data to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements across supply chains and multiple operations. Define and refine supply chain and operating models for various business lines.

- Cross-Functional Partnership & Operational Support: Partner with Operations and Retail teams to advise on and manage fulfilment challenges, driving resolution and continuous improvement within warehouse environments.

- Project Planning & Coordination: Support the planning and organisation of complex, cross-functional projects that improve supply chain performance and operational outcomes.


A day in the life
Being a Supply Chain Manager for Amazon involves lots of problem solving. You’ll work with a number of teams to navigate challenges as and when situations impact our network. You’ll spend time resolving temporary issues and looking at the bigger picture to drive Amazon towards achieving new objectives. This role is both proactive and reactive, and you’ll have the opportunity to help forecast and plan for new projects.

As a Supply Chain Manager, you’ll need to help with both on-the-ground tasks and more tactical work. No two days will be the same. You could spend one day helping to define our supply chain and operating models and the next assisting with a site’s resource plan for a busy period. Having so much variety in your role means you’ll be able to learn something new every day.

This role can be carried out from our corporate locations in London.

About the team
Our Amazon R2L INTL Supply Chain team breathes life into our newest ideas and incubates them until they grow into sophisticated businesses. We’ve got the energy of an exciting start-up, as our team works on Amazon’s next big project, under the umbrella of one of the world’s biggest companies.

We work behind the scenes to support new areas of the business - like Amazon Sub Same Day Groceries, Quick Commerce and our online grocery service. There are lots of opportunities for every skill set, from operations to supply chain to data management.

Our goal is to help develop new capabilities within Amazon on behalf of our customers. This entrepreneurial team has a deep understanding of the needs of our customers, employees and partners and helps to develop Amazon businesses of all sizes.

We grow new opportunities that will help Amazon diversify even more, taking them from concepts to mature operations that operate as standalone businesses. This dynamic environment supports our people’s growth and development.
